# Staff Product Manager

$172k - $215k

Fuze Health

[Florida, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Florida%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3474468873178910317?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9630&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1243631546462319689&crId=US_0US_0)

## **Job Summary** At Fuze Health, we put patients first and tirelessly address the most pressing needs in healthcare. We empower millions to digitally connect with care providers, essential health resources and needed treatments – and enable care providers, employers, health plans and life sciences companies to meaningfully enhance quality, outcomes and value. We are dedicated to helping our partners evolve and modernize to meet emerging patient and marketplace needs. Fuze Health’s foundation is built upon the strategic combination of several proven, technology-powered innovators in the digital health, diagnostics, and pharmacy sectors. Our growing portfolio brings together the capabilities of industry leaders including LetsGetChecked, Truepill, and Alto Pharmacy, to create a distinctive, unified force in healthcare. Together, we have the shared vision, advanced capabilities and talented teams to deliver next-generation solutions that patients and healthcare partners need today and into the future.

## **Job Description**

The Staff Product Manager at FuzeRx is a senior individual contributor role responsible for defining, shaping, and delivering high-impact product initiatives that advance patient care, pharmacy operations, and strategic growth. This role sits within the Product Management job family and represents the highest level of product craftsmanship and influence without direct people management.

As a Staff Product Manager, you will operate with significant autonomy, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Clinical, Pharmacy Operations, Data, and Business leaders to solve complex problems at scale. This role is expected to set product standards, influence product strategy across domains, and mentor other Product Managers while driving measurable outcomes aligned with FuzeRx’s mission and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for complex, high-impact product areas, from discovery and strategy through delivery, launch, and optimization

- Define product vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmaps aligned to company goals, patient outcomes, and operational efficiency

- Partner deeply with Engineering, Design, Data, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex business and clinical needs into clear product requirements

- Lead product discovery through customer research, data analysis, experimentation, and validation to ensure solutions solve real user problems

- Drive alignment across senior stakeholders by clearly articulating tradeoffs, priorities, and outcomes using data and strong product judgment

- Establish and monitor success metrics (KPIs/OKRs), using insights to iterate and continuously improve product performance

- Anticipate regulatory, operational, and technical constraints in healthcare and pharmacy environments and design scalable, compliant solutions

- Serve as a product thought leader and mentor, raising the bar for product quality, execution, and decision-making across the Product organization


**Required Experience & Qualifications:**

Minimum Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- 8+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, including ownership of complex, cross-functional product initiatives

- Demonstrated experience leading products from concept to launch in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

- Experience working closely with Engineering teams in agile development environments

- Strong analytical skills with experience defining and using product metrics to drive decision-making

- Experience operating in regulated or highly complex domains (e.g., healthcare, pharmacy, fintech, or enterprise platforms)

- Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without authority

- Proficiency with common product and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Figma, Productboard, Slack, GSuite)


Preferred Qualifications:

- MBA or advanced degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Data, or a related field

- Experience building products for pharmacy, healthcare services, life sciences, or medication management platforms

- Experience with data-driven personalization, automation, or AI-enabled product capabilities

- Proven track record of setting product strategy at the portfolio or platform level

- Experience mentoring or coaching other Product Managers and contributing to product org maturity


## **Additional Information**

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. At this time, Fuze Health is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa.

Travel: No - Required up to 0% of the time

Physical requirements for this role include the ability to work at a computer terminal with monitor, keyboard and mouse for extended periods of time, stoop, bend, and reach for equipment and supplies, make frequent repetitive motions required to operate a computer that include the wrists, hands and fingers, and lift, carry, push, pull, and move light objects up to 20 pounds. The role also requires the ability to effectively communicate through verbal interactions, discern auditory information, and visually perceive details to perform essential job functions.

_Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and similar applicable state laws, it is Fuze Health’s policy to provide reasonable accommodation to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship._

**Salary and Benefits**

Compensation Range: $172,000-$215,000/annually

The compensation range provided reflects the applicable national market range for this role and may vary based on the candidate's geographic location, experience, and qualifications.

Commission Eligible: No

Annual Incentive Bonus Eligible: Yes

Equity Eligible: Yes

Benefits: Full-time employee benefits include: dental, vision, and multiple group medical plans to choose from, a 401(k) retirement savings plan, group life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, flexible spending account (FSA) and health savings account (HSA), commuter benefits, employer-paid short-term (STD) and long-term disability (LTD) insurance, and additional supplemental insurance plans (spouse life insurance, legal insurance, an employee assistance program, home health testing kits, and a fertility medication discount program). Employees are also provided flexible vacation time, accrued paid sick time, 10 paid holidays, (2 floating holidays for full time non-exempt employees) , and eight weeks of paid parental leave for eligible employees, additional paid weeks for the birthing parent, 4 weeks paid caregiver leave, and a Lifestyle Spending Account allowance each month.

More Benefits Information Here: Fuze Health Benefits Site .

Application deadline: October 31, 2026

# Technical Staff Product Manager - Data

Full-time

ApartmentIQ

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7824077709390436526?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=354&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4507023264957165257&crId=US_0US_0)

**We’re Changing the PropTech Industry**

We’re a profitable, growth-stage company building industry-leading martech and data products for the PropTech space. Our focus is on our category-leading AI and data SaaS products with triple-digit growth rates.

We’re a fully remote team of 100+ spread across the U.S. from coast to coast. We operate on a strict no a\*\*holes policy and are proud to have built a community of highly performant people that take our work seriously, but not ourselves. And, we're looking for exceptional people to help further accelerate our growth.

While we’ve raised $30MM+ to date from some of the world’s best investors, we’re profitable with a strong balance sheet and an indefinite runway. We pride ourselves on achieving rapid growth without having to incinerate capital.

**About Our Products**

ApartmentIQ is the all-in-one data platform powering smarter decisions across multifamily—covering 40M units with daily property and market intelligence used for surveys, research, and revenue management. We're trusted by 65% of the NMHC Top 50. Our sister company, MavenAI, delivers AI-powered marketing automation built by industry experts and integrated directly with property management systems, serving over 2M units.

We’re looking for a Technical Staff Product Manager to own ApartmentIQ’s data platform, the foundation behind the market intelligence multifamily operators rely on every day. This role is for someone with a data science or analytics background who is as comfortable writing SQL and digging into a pipeline as they are setting product direction.

You’ll set the vision and roadmap for how we ingest, model, validate, and deliver data, working closely with data engineering, data science, and product teams. When something looks off, you’ll dig in yourself: run the analysis, trace the issue to its root cause, and turn what you find into fixes and platform improvements. You’ll also work directly with customers to learn how they use our data,

**Responsibilities**

- Own the strategy and roadmap for the data platform, including ingestion, data models, data quality, and delivery to internal and customer facing products
- Lead root cause analysis on data quality issues, anomalies, and metric discrepancies, and work with engineering on fixes that last
- Define data quality standards, SLAs, and monitoring so issues are caught before they reach customers
- Partner with data engineering and data science to scope technical requirements, weigh tradeoffs, and prioritize the backlog
- Turn the needs of internal data users (product, analytics, data science, customer success) and multifamily operators into clear platform requirements
- Define and track the metrics that measure platform health, adoption, and business impact
- Evaluate data sources, vendors, and partnerships that expand the depth and accuracy of our market intelligence
- Explain technical concepts clearly to non technical stakeholders and leadership

**Qualifications**

- 8+ years of combined experience in product management, data science, or data analytics, including at least 4 years managing data products or data platforms
- Background in data science, analytics, or a quantitative field such as statistics, economics, or computer science
- A track record of root cause analysis on complex data issues, from spotting the anomaly to shipping the fix
- Solid understanding of modern data stack concepts: pipelines, ETL/ELT, data warehousing (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or similar), data modeling, and data quality tooling
- Experience working closely with data engineers and data scientists, with enough technical depth to earn their trust and challenge assumptions
- Ability to turn ambiguous, messy data problems into clear priorities and actionable product plans
- Experience in a fast moving B2B SaaS environment; real estate, PropTech, or market data experience is a plus

**Why Choose Us**

- **Remote-First:** We offer the freedom to work from home across most of the U.S. You’ll enjoy the flexibility of remote work, balanced with high-energy in-person offsites to build real connections and celebrate our wins together.
- **Competitive Compensation:** We believe in hiring the best and paying accordingly. You’ll receive acompetitive salary that reflects your impact and expertise.
- **Paid Time Off:** Take the time you need with our flexible vacation policy and dedicated paid parental leave to support you and your family’s biggest milestones.
- **Your Health Matters** : Stay healthy with high-quality Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plans for you and your family.
- **Peace of Mind (On Us):** We fully invest in your security with 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Basic Life Insurance.
- **Protection for Your Whole Crew:** Access supplemental insurance for the unexpected, plus specialized coverage to keep your pets happy and healthy, too.
- **Invest in Your Future:** Secure your financial goals with our 401k Program, helping you build for the long term while you help us build the company.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process, please contact your recruiter.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

We want to alert you to potential recruiting scams targeting job seekers. Please note that our company will never request payment, personal information, or any confidential details during the interview process.

# Senior Technical Product Manager

Full-time

Bjak

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2630313457461590089?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=3855284256290005054&crId=US_0US_0)

## About There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

## Role

- Define product roadmaps, requirements and success metrics for assigned product areas

- Identify user needs and translate them into product features, workflows and specifications

- Evaluate technical approaches with engineering, balancing performance, reliability, usability and development effort

- Lead product development from planning and design through testing, launch and improvement

- Analyse user behaviour, product performance and experiments to improve adoption, engagement and retention

- Assess market opportunities, competing products and user feedback to guide product priorities


## **What You'll Need**

- 5+ years of product management experience, including shipping technology products

- Strong system design knowledge and the ability to evaluate architecture, data models, integrations, reliability and performance trade-offs

- Ability to challenge technical proposals, identify architectural risks and work with engineering to resolve complex product and system constraints

- Experience owning complex products or workflows end-to-end, from problem definition and technical scoping through launch and production iteration

- Ability to balance quality, latency, reliability, development cost and time-to-market when making product decisions

- Proven track record of improving adoption, engagement, retention or business outcomes through shipped products

- Strong analytical judgment and experience designing experiments, interpreting metrics and making investment decisions based on evidence


## **Nice to Have**

- Experience with distributed systems, complex integrations

- Experience with AI/ML products or LLM-based applications

- Experience with workflow automation or other technically demanding products.

$141.6k - $177k

Full-time

Cobalt

### **Who We Are** Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY. Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform and an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 400 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface. Cobalt is an equal-opportunity employer, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce. At Cobalt, we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations to continue to nurture our unique, rich, diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work. **Description** Modern software demands continuous security validation. Cobalt is pioneering the evolution beyond legacy, point-in-time PTaaS through our Autonomous and Continuous pentesting platform-providing continuous, scalable, and AI-driven security coverage across enterprise environments. In the role of **Senior Technical Product Manager** , you will shape the strategic product vision, steer live initiatives, and spearhead 0-to-1 feature development to drive business ROI across Cobalt’s Autonomous and Continuous Pentesting portfolio. You will conduct deep product discovery, instill scalable PM leadership practices, and redefine how continuous, autonomous offensive security is delivered to modern enterprises. You will combine strong business acumen with technical rigor, driving clear feature ownership from discovery to delivery. Operating as a proactive cross-functional leader, you will challenge existing processes and communicate transparently to ensure our continuous pentesting platform solves critical customer security problems with measurable impact. **What You Would Do** As a member of a growing team of product managers your responsibilities include: - **Strategic PM Leadership & Business ROI:** Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for the Autonomous and Continuous pentesting portfolio. Align feature scope directly with customer value and measurable business outcomes, tracking clear adoption and retention metrics. - **Product Discovery Excellence:** Lead continuous customer discovery and market validation to identify high-impact customer problems in the continuous security testing space. Translate complex user needs into actionable, validated product requirements. - **End-to-End Feature Ownership:** Take full operational ownership of product features across the entire lifecycle—from initial ideation and specification to execution, deployment, and post-launch evaluation. - **Proactive Leadership & Process Innovation:** Actively challenge inefficient workflows, implement scalable product processes, and foster high alignment across engineering, design, marketing, and executive stakeholders. - **Transparent & Structured Communication:** Maintain standard executive-level visibility into roadmap progress, product decisions, and operational metrics through regular updates and clear artifact documentation. - **Domain Expertise in Autonomous Security:** Serve as the internal subject matter expert on continuous vulnerability management, AI-driven offensive security techniques, and automated pentesting workflows. - **Data-Driven Performance Management:** Define and monitor rigorous success criteria, evaluating product performance against strategic business metrics and customer satisfaction outcomes. **You Must Have** - 8+ years of Product Management experience with expertise in strategic leadership, end-to-end feature ownership, and delivering tangible business ROI, including 5+ years in cybersecurity products and preferably 3+ years in offensive security. - Proven track record in continuous product discovery, conducting user research, and validating continuous or automated security offerings. - Experience driving autonomous or continuous or security solutions, vulnerability management platforms, or related enterprise offensive security offerings. - Strong proactive leadership capability with a willingness to challenge processes, streamline workflows, and eliminate operational friction. - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills across technical teams, leadership, and external customer audiences. - Strong written and verbal communication skills. You’re great at explaining highly technical topics to technical and non technical audiences, with a talent for building empathy for user problems. - Strong analytical capabilities is a plus. - Strong bias for action, creative thinking, innovation and data-driven product decision-making. - A can-do attitude and ability to juggle multiple priorities simultaneously. - Experience with agile software development. - Experience working with global team members in a remote environment.

### **Why You Should Join Us**

- Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry
- Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities
- Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan
- Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU)
- Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU)
- Leverage stipends for:
- Wellness
- Work-from-home equipment & wifi
- Learning & development
- Make the most of our flexible, generous paid time off and paid parental leave

**Build What Matters at RevStar**

**Position:** Senior Product Manager

- **Reports To:** Product Management Lead/Practice Lead
- **Location** : Remote (AZ, FL, TX)
- **Employment Type:** Full-Time W2

**Job Summary**

Are you an energetic product leader who thrives at the intersection of client strategy, cloud-native engineering, and cutting-edge AI? RevStar is an AI-first innovation shop and AWS Advanced Tier Partner building transformative digital products for enterprise clients. We are seeking a client-facing Product Manager / Sr. Product Manager to own product delivery from discovery to launch. In this role, you will lead cross-functional engineering teams, run discovery workshops, leverage AI tools for rapid prototyping, and partner directly with client executives to translate complex business needs into high-impact software. Above all, the ideal candidate embodies RevStar’s core values:

- **Self-Mastery** : We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.
- **Ownership** : We own outcomes, not just effort.
- **Shared Destiny** : We rise or fall together.

### Your Impact Pillars

Your day-to-day contributions are organized into four strategic areas:

1\. **Product Vision & Client Strategy**

- Facilitate client discovery sessions (onsite and virtual) to define product roadmaps, MVP boundaries, and success metrics.
- Translate client vision into actionable Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), prioritized feature backlogs, and detailed user stories.
- Conduct client product demos and manage stakeholder expectations across project analysis, design, and execution phases.

2\. **Delivery & Team Enablement**

- Lead cross-functional pods of engineers, architects, and designers using Agile/Scrum methodologies.
- Establish a "shared brain" across teams to unblock engineering, eliminate delivery friction, and empower autonomous decision-making.
- Drive project governance inside Azure DevOps, maintaining clean backlogs, accurate tracking, and high delivery velocity.

3\. **AI Prototyping & Modern Workflows**

- Utilize generative AI tools and modern rapid-prototyping platforms (like v0) to generate wireframes and validate user experiences fast.
- Continuously explore and implement emerging AI workflows to accelerate client communication, requirements gathering, and design iterations.

4\. **Account Leadership & Growth**

- Serve as the primary client point-of-contact, building trust through proactive communication, delivery updates, and value creation.
- Guide clients through complex technical tradeoffs, scope management, and risk mitigation.

**Requirements**

### **What You Bring**

- Experience: 3+ years of full-lifecycle Product Management experience within a client-facing, consultancy, or agency environment.
- Product Mastery: Strong understanding of MVP prioritization frameworks, user story mapping, PRD development, and Agile/Scrum delivery.
- Modern Tooling: Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, and AI-assisted design/prototyping tools (e.g., v0).
- Domain Exposure (Preferred): Familiarity with AWS cloud-native services or healthcare platforms/HIPAA compliance standards is a strong plus.

### **Preferred**

- Experience with AWS
- Experience with Healthcare platforms & HIPAA security standards
- Experience with Azure DevOps or other project management tools
- Experience with Github

**Benefits**

- **Paid Time Off**– Take the time you need to recharge and stay productive.
- **Remote-First Working Environment** – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
- **Comprehensive Health Coverage** – Medical, Dental, Vision
- **401(k) Retirement Plan** – Plan for your future with access to a company-sponsored 401(k) program.
- **Annual Learning & Development Stipend** – Invest in your skills with conferences, certifications, or courses.
- **Peer Mentorship & Coaching** – Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth.
- **Professional Growth Opportunities** – Exposure to cutting-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries.
- **Company Outings & Volunteer Opportunities** – Build relationships and give back to the community.
- **Collaborative, Innovative Culture** – Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

$160k - $200k

32fd2dce-acde-405b-8949-f07aedc66ae5

**Principal Product Manager** **United States (Remote)**

**About us** Advanced Solutions International is a global software company focused on helping not-for-profits and membership organizations grow revenue, reduce expenses, improve performance, engage and serve members and donors through innovative software solutions. Our portfolio of solutions includes the iMIS Engagement Management System, TopClass LMS, OpenWater application and review software, and the Clowder mobile app.

**About our position** ASI is looking for a Principal Product Manager, Platform & Ecosystem to lead the product strategy for the shared capabilities that connect ASI’s software portfolio and enable customers, partners, and developers to extend it. This is a product leadership role focused on commercial outcomes, customer value, interoperability, and ecosystem adoption- not an engineering architecture or infrastructure management position.

The ideal candidate has delivered successful API and integration products and understands how shared platform investments translate into customer value and portfolio growth. Practical experience with AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), secure tool access, and emerging interoperability patterns is important. This leader will work closely with architects, product leaders, partners, and customers, owning product direction while Engineering owns implementation and technical architecture.

**What you’ll be doing**

- Defining a platform and ecosystem vision spanning APIs, integration services, developer experience, shared identity and authentication, extensibility, and AI-ready capabilities, with Model Context Protocol (MCP) as a core strategic priority.
- Owning the product roadmap and business use cases for MCP-enabled access to ASI capabilities and data, including AI agent interoperability, secure tool and resource exposure, permissions, governance, and developer/partner adoption; partnering with Engineering on protocol implementation and architecture.
- Prioritizing platform investments based on customer needs, partner demand, implementation friction, cross-sell enablement, and measurable business impact.
- Partnering with Engineering architects and platform teams on technical feasibility, security, standards, reliability, and delivery; Engineering owns technical architecture.
- Working with portfolio PMs to define shared capabilities that support iMIS, OpenWater, TopClass, Clowder, and integrations with third-party AMS and adjacent systems.
- Building a clear developer and partner experience: documentation requirements, onboarding, API discoverability, versioning expectations, and integration lifecycle.
- Defining platform metrics including API adoption, active integrations, partner activation, integration, implementation time, reliability, and portfolio attach-rate contribution.
- Leading customer, partner, and internal discovery; building business cases and making pragmatic build, buy, and partner recommendations.
- Coordinating with Strategic Partnerships, Security, Cloud/DevOps, Design, and product teams to establish a coherent ecosystem roadmap.
- Performing other job-related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**What we want you to have**

- 8+ years of product management experience, including ownership of B2B SaaS platforms, APIs, developer products, or integration ecosystems.
- Demonstrated success translating technical platform capabilities into customer adoption, partner value, or revenue outcomes.
- Strong fluency in API products, identity concepts, integration patterns, developer experience, and enterprise SaaS interoperability.
- Practical experience shipping AI-enabled platform integrations, agent/tool connectivity, with an understanding of secure data access, authorization, interoperability, and the evolving AI developer ecosystem.
- Hands-on experience with MCP servers/clients, agent tool-use ecosystems, AI integration frameworks, or comparable emerging standards; ability to evaluate evolving approaches pragmatically.
- Excellent prioritization and executive communication skills, including comfort balancing shared-platform needs across multiple product teams.
- Ability to partner credibly with engineering architects without confusing product strategy with technical architecture ownership.
- Experience in association technology, enterprise applications, CRM/AMS ecosystems, or acquired multi-product software portfolios.
- Experience with partner marketplaces, integration hubs, iPaaS, or developer communities.

**What we offer**

At ASI, we've forged an employee-first culture, fostering a dynamic and cohesive environment where collaboration thrives, and continuous improvement is our focus. Over the past 30 years, we’ve established a solid foundation for long-term success by empowering our team to challenge the status quo and driving positive change by encouraging new ideas, fresh perspectives, and positive attitudes.

**Compensation**

The compensation for this position is determined based on a wide variety of factors, including but not limited to an individual’s skill set, experience, training, certifications, education, and geographic location, as well as business needs and internal equity. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $160,000- $200,000.

RevStar

**Build What Matters at RevStar**

**Position:** Senior Product Manager, Migrations

- **Reports To:** Product Management Lead/Practice Lead
- **Location** : Remote (AZ, FL, TX)
- **Employment Type:** Full-Time W2

**Job Summary**

Build what matters as a Delivery Lead for the Migration service area at RevStar. RevStar is a fast-growing cloud-native software and modernization consultancy focused on helping organizations migrate, modernize, and scale on AWS. We are seeking a hands-on Delivery Lead to own the successful execution of AWS migration engagements from kickoff through stabilization. This role sits right at the intersection of technical delivery, solution execution, and client partnership. You will lead cross-functional teams, participate in architecture discussions, and drive risk mitigation to deliver projects on time and within scope. Above all, the ideal candidate embodies RevStar’s core values:

- **Self-Mastery:** We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.
- **Ownership** : We own outcomes, not just effort.
- **Shared Destiny:** We rise or fall together.

### Your Impact Pillars

1. **Migration Execution & Technical Leadership:** Lead AWS migration projects across discovery, planning, execution, cutover, and post-migration stabilization. Partner closely with Solutions Architects and Engineers on migration strategies (re-host, re-platform, refactor), dependency mapping, and rollback plans. Participate directly in backlog refinement, estimation, and workstream sequencing to ensure pre-sales architecture plans execute smoothly in delivery.
2. **Client Partnership & Account Ownership:** Serve as the primary delivery point of contact for migration clients, managing expectations, scope, risks, and escalations. Lead internal and external status calls, aligning migration timelines and success criteria directly with client business objectives. Schedule and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) while identifying follow-on modernization and expansion opportunities alongside Sales and Solutions Architecture.
3. **Team Operations & Delivery Governance:** Oversee project assignments and team allocations across active engagements while monitoring pending sales forecasts to keep recruiting informed. Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, DevOps, QA, and Product to maintain clean delivery milestones and transition phases. Enforce RevStar quality gates, migration playbooks, and delivery standards using tools like Jira and Azure DevOps.

**Requirements**

**What You Bring**

- Core Experience: 3+ years in technical delivery leadership, engineering leadership, or consulting within cloud or modernization spaces.
- Technical Depth: Solid grasp of cloud infrastructure fundamentals (networking, compute, storage, IAM) and hands-on experience running large-scale cloud migrations.
- Delivery Mastery: Full lifecycle Agile/Scrum delivery experience with a proven track record of driving clarity through technical ambiguity.
- Nice-to-Haves: Active AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect Associate/Professional), experience in regulated frameworks (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI), or professional consulting background.

**Benefits**

- **Paid Time Off** – Take the time you need to recharge and stay productive.
- **Remote-First Working Environment** – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
- **Comprehensive Health Coverage** – Medical, Dental, Vision
- **401(k) Retirement Plan** – Plan for your future with access to a company-sponsored 401(k) program.
- **Annual Learning & Development Stipend** – Invest in your skills with conferences, certifications, or courses.
- **Peer Mentorship & Coaching** – Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth.
- **Professional Growth Opportunities** – Exposure to cutting-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries.
- **Company Outings & Volunteer Opportunities** – Build relationships and give back to the community.
- **Collaborative, Innovative Culture** – Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

Toppan Merrill

Shape the Future of AI in Capital Markets and Legal Disclosure
At Toppan Merrill, we're building Quinn , a cloud-based platform that helps law firms, investment banks, and public companies draft, review, and file SEC documents, including IPO registration statements, prospectuses, proxy statements, and annual and quarterly reports.
We're applying AI to one of the most consequential document workflows in the world, where precision, trust, and accountability matter the most. This is a unique opportunity to join a small, highly visible team and help define the future of AI-assisted financial disclosure. You'll work directly with senior engineering leadership, engage with some of the world's largest law firms, and help shape a product already supported by a working prototype and strong market interest.
Most importantly, you'll be the first AI-dedicated Product Owner for Quinn. Your leadership will ensure we're building the right solutions for customers and bringing clarity, prioritization, and rigor to every product decision.
As Principal Product Owner, you will lead product discovery and product execution for Quinn’s AI capabilities, translating Quinn’s broader product strategy into validated AI solutions and prioritized delivery.
You'll partner closely with engineering, legal, security, sales, and customers to translate market needs into innovative, practical solutions that professionals can trust.
Own and prioritize the Quinn AI product backlog.

- Define and maintain the Quinn AI roadmap, release priorities, and measurable success criteria in alignment with the broader Quinn product strategy.
- Create detailed user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria that enable engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
- Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business priorities, and regulatory requirements when making product decisions.

Customer & Partner Engagement

- Lead product discovery with customers and design partners to understand workflows, identify unmet needs, validate concepts, and assess product-market fit.
- Translate discovery insights into hypotheses, product decisions, experiments, and prioritized development opportunities.”
- Distinguish problems that warrant AI solutions from those better addressed through conventional product capabilities or workflow changes.
- AI Product Delivery
- Define the scope, success criteria, and acceptance standards for AI-powered features.
- Establish quality thresholds for capabilities that attorneys and financial professionals will rely on in critical SEC reporting workflows.
- Define evaluation frameworks and quality thresholds for AI capabilities, including accuracy, groundedness, completeness, consistency, and appropriate human oversight.”
- Partner with Engineering to establish representative evaluation datasets, regression testing, and feedback loops that measure AI quality over time.
- Define what AI features should and should not do within customer documents.
- Collaborate with Legal, Security, and Engineering teams to define appropriate handling of customer content and sensitive documents.
- Ensure AI capabilities align with security, compliance, privacy, and governance requirements.
- Help shape responsible AI practices within a highly regulated environment.

Establish a structured product discovery approach for Quinn AI and begin discovery with prospective and confirmed design partners.

- Take ownership of the Quinn AI backlog and establish clear product priorities aligned with the broader Quinn roadmap.
- Build strong partnerships with Engineering, Legal, Security, and executive stakeholders.
- Establish quality standards and decision-making frameworks for AI-driven features.

7+ years of product management or product ownership experience delivering B2B software solutions.

- Experience launching AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation capabilities for professional users.
- Strong experience writing product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
- Experience in legal technology, capital markets, SEC reporting, financial disclosure, compliance software, or other regulated industries.
- Experience leading design partner, beta, pilot, or early-access customer programs.
- Familiarity with how law firms evaluate and approve technology, including security reviews, data privacy considerations, and vendor risk assessments.
- Experience working with SaaS and cloud-based enterprise platforms.

Please note that actual salaries may vary within, above, or below this range based on factors such as education, training, experience, professional achievement, business needs, and location.
Enhanced Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance for employees and dependents

- Paid time off including vacation, sick, community involvement, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays.
- Paid community involvement/volunteer days
- Wellness Resources and Employee Assistance Programming

## **About Property Meld** Property Meld's mission is to radically improve how the property management industry handles maintenance, through our Intelligent Maintenance platform. If you have ever had a maintenance issue at a rental, you know how painful it can be to get fixed. It does not have to be this way. We are rethinking the entire experience to drive maintenance cost toward the minimum and make residents and owners want to stay with their property manager, not leave.

#### **The role**

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own outcomes for a meaningful part of our product. You are accountable for solving problems that create real value, for our customers and for the business, not for shipping features. A shipped feature is a bet, not a result. Your job is to make the right bets and to carry them through to value customers actually recognize.

This is a role for someone who wants to own the whole arc of a problem: understanding it deeply, deciding what to do with your design and engineering partners, and staying with the work through launch and beyond to confirm it landed. If your ideal job is writing requirements and handing them off, this is not it. If it is living with a problem until customers rely on the answer, it is.

You will often be the only product person in the room, and what you decide there holds.

#### **What you will own**

**Outcomes, not output.** You hold two questions at once: do customers get real value (desirability), and does the business (viability, which in our subscription model means strengthening why customers subscribe, expand, and stay).

**The "why" behind every bet — including the ones nobody asked for.** Before work earns a place on the roadmap, you make the case for it in writing: the problem, the job the customer is trying to get done, the outcome you expect, and why the bet will work. Responding well to inbound requests is table stakes at this level, not the job — you connect your work to where the business needs to be beyond the current cycle.

**Recognized value, not satisfaction.** A happy customer is a weak signal. You push past sentiment to whether customers recognize value they cannot do without, because that is what earns renewal.

**Carrying the "why" to everyone.** You are the face of the product trio to the rest of the company, and to customers directly. You package the reason, the outcome, and the value so the team, our customer-facing teams, and customers can each act on it. Value that is never understood is never realized.

#### **How you will work**

**In a product trio.** You discover and decide alongside design and engineering, before the build, not by passing specs over a wall. The strongest solutions come from value, usability, and feasibility being reasoned about together.

**Close to customers, continuously.** Staying grounded in first-hand customer reality is a standing habit, not a kickoff phase.

**Across the whole lifecycle.** You stay engaged from the problem through delivery, rollout, and measurement. Staying close to the build and to QA is how you earn the technical fluency that makes you sharper at the job over time.

**Through influence, not authority.** You rarely manage the people you work with. Your job is to create clarity, alignment, and momentum in every direction without relying on positional power.

**What we are looking for**

We hire for how you work, not where you have worked, and we hire for culture add, not culture fit: people who bring something we do not already have.

**Deep customer curiosity.** You listen to understand, stay close to the people who use the product, and dig for the value they recognize, not just whether they seem content.

**Evidence over ego.** You hold your convictions strongly but loosely, and you change course when the evidence says a bet will miss.

**Priority discipline, earned.** You protect focus, can say no in a way earned by consistently delivering, and push for better evidence before the team commits to work.

**Clear in writing and in the room.** You can build a written, persuasive argument, and you can also command a room and distill a crisp value proposition when it matters.

**Measurement literacy.** You choose metrics that track both the customer's outcome and the business consequence — not vanity numbers — and you combine quantitative signal with qualitative understanding of why.

**Collaborative ownership.** You share credit generously and can still speak clearly to what you contributed. You take responsibility rather than assign blame.

**A generalist who prefers a team.** You could run as a one-person band, but you would rather work with strong specialists. You do not hand off understanding of the technical side even when you lean on engineers to teach you, and you treat every gap as a muscle to build.

**Self-directed and driven by purpose.** You bring your own autonomy, keep building your own mastery, and carry the "why" so naturally that the people around you absorb it.

PropertyTech experience is a plus.

#### **The details**

$140,000–$170,000 annual base salary, plus a 10% annual bonus opportunity based on applicable performance criteria.

Candidates must be eligible for full-time employment in the United States.

The product team at Property Meld is a remote-work organization. However, there is an opportunity for hybrid or in-office work in Rapid City, SD. We require 6 hours of overlap time, daily, with the Mountain Time Zone.

While the position is remote, but some travel is required. This role comes with the expectation of two company headquarter visits per year. Once a year the whole company gets together for a week to get to know each other and better understand the big picture of how each department and role works, and once a year we gather for our MX Summit, where you will mingle with customers and deepen your industry knowledge.

Twice per year the product team gets together in the same physical location to get to know each other better and work through interesting challenges together. In addition, once a quarter, on your schedule, you are expected to visit with a customer and shadow them, learning how they are using and not using our product.

Our benefits package is designed to be part of our employees' story of living well:

- Healthcare, dental, and vision coverage

- Aflac

- 1 week Meld Cares time off (volunteer time)

- Sick leave

- Paid Holidays

- Life insurance

- Employee Assistance Program

- Gym membership discounts

- Professional development, training, and coaching


We value diverse points of view and know that our differences make us stronger. We believe in fostering a place to work that is open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive, and healthy. We strongly encourage applications from individuals who are under-represented in the tech industry, across color, creed, race, ethnic and national origin, physical ability, gender, and sexual identity, or any other basis.

##### Product Manager

Are you passionate about using the power of communication data to build intelligent, intuitive AI experiences? Do you thrive on owning a product area – from discovering what customers need to shipping it with your engineering team? If so, Intermedia's AI & Data Product Management team is seeking a hands-on Product Manager to help deliver the next generation of AI-powered capabilities across our UCaaS and CCaaS products. This is a role for a product manager ready to own a slice of the roadmap end to end – more ownership and customer-facing discovery than a product owner, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and UX to turn ideas into products customers love.

Intermedia is a leading provider of cloud-based communication and collaboration solutions, empowering over 140,000 businesses and 7,500 partners with UCaaS, CCaaS, and productivity tools. We're committed to delivering secure, easy-to-use solutions, backed by industry-leading reliability and support. Our AI & Data team is at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the wealth of communication data generated across our platforms to develop intelligent tools and insights that drive customer success. We believe in a collaborative, hands-on approach where every team member contributes their unique skills to create products that truly make a difference. We are a roll-up-your-sleeves-and-get-into-the-details product management team where, irrespective of your position, you can contribute your skills and energies to help improve our products.

As a Product Manager on the AI & Data team, you will own a product area within our AI portfolio, defining what to build and why, and partnering directly with engineering to deliver it. You will run discovery with customers and stakeholders, shape a prioritized roadmap for your area, write clear requirements, and see features through from concept to launch. You will use metrics and customer feedback to understand how your product is performing and where to invest next. Your focus will be on AI-driven experiences, requiring strong analytical skills, a good sense for UI/UX and usability, and excellent communication. You will work with globally distributed teams, making effective asynchronous communication essential. This is a mid-level role ideal for someone who combines ownership and product judgment with strong, detail-oriented delivery. You'll help shape the strategy and roadmap for your product area and own how it gets delivered — the broader, longer-term vision for the area is set in partnership with the Senior Product Manager or team lead.

# Senior Product Manager

$190k - $230k

Full-time

Ashby

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1980753129071006402?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=234&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6272968794150219484&crId=US_0US_0)

Hi, I’m Geo, Ashby’s VP of Product. I joined Ashby August ‘26; read more about why I joined here. I’m hiring for multiple Product Managers who will report directly to me. More on the specific product areas below.

At Ashby, we have a unique approach to building products . As a PM, your primary goal is to eliminate frustration and bring delight to our customers. You’ll work with engineers who deeply understand the customer and business problem and own the solution end-to-end. This means that you spend less time writing detailed specs and more time with customers and doing deep product thinking.

Our unique approach is working. We’re growing >100% year over year and have notable customers such as Notion, Linear, OpenAI, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best in class among our peers. We’re backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more!

## Product Areas

From day one, we have aimed to build "all-in-one and best-in-class" software for Talent teams. In addition to building a multi-product foundation from day one, we have also focused on enabling customizability and power-user features while keeping Ashby easy to get started with. Doing both is an ambitious undertaking!

We want to continue down this ambitious path in future and add multiple new products, which means we:

- Are not just building a product, we’re building a platform

- Need to find a balance between re-usable building blocks and feature-specific behaviour

- Blend enterprise customizability and ease of use


We also want to continuously delight users. We hear "I never thought one could fall in love with an ATS" quite often, and we want to keep that true for all future products we build.

We are looking for Product Managers who can own the roadmap and strategy for the following areas:

1. **Outbound Sourcing:** You’ll build a platform that enables teams to hire sourcing agents directly from Ashby. Customers simply write the job description, and agents start booking calls with highly qualified candidates.

2. **Product Platform:** Ashby was designed from the beginning as a multi-product platform. We’re looking for a PM to establish this team and own the shared building blocks, foundational capabilities, and APIs that let product teams move quickly.

3. **AI Platform:** You’ll own the Ashby Assistant, Ashby MCP, and the AI platform used across many product surfaces. You’ll help drive shared primitives, such as AI memory and context.


During the interview process, we’ll determine which role you're best suited for. We’re also advertising this opening as **Staff Product Manager** . Both titles describe the same position; please apply once using the title that best reflects your experience.

## Your Role

- **Drive Impact:** Deeply understand our customers and ship impactful product improvements and investments to maintain our strong velocity.


- **Quality:** Apply your strong product taste and sound judgement to deliver solutions that are both powerful and a joy to use. Use your judgment to identify areas where we need to improve quality before shipping.


- **Prioritization and Strategy:** Maintain a roadmap to ensure engineering is never blocked, and set a compelling strategy and vision for the next 6-18 months.

- **Customer Research:** Spend time with customers and customer-facing teams. Synthesize customer feedback, research, and competitive intel to drive smart prioritization choices.


- **Execution Excellence:** Set the pace for your product area by identifying bottlenecks, scoping effectively, and driving projects toward high-impact releases. Stay close to engineering work to navigate tradeoffs, manage technical risks, and resolve execution challenges.


- **Cross-functional Collaboration:** Partner across go-to-market teams to bring the features and products your team builds to the market. Anticipate and plan for the needs to help inform pricing, marketing, and customer support.


- **Ownership and reliability:** follow through on commitments, manage time ruthlessly, respond promptly to stakeholders, and communicate proactively when priorities or timelines change.


### You could be a great fit if

- You have an unnatural curiosity and excitement about the end-user and the jobs they do

- You bring an Engineering mindset to product problems and can think through edge cases and understand how to extend our underlying platform to create leverage

- You can demonstrate taste - you care about the quality of the products you build and use

- You're an excellent writer and synthesizer; you bring product knowledge and clarity to the entire organization and enable Engineers with product insights

- You can build a thesis for prioritization and communicate priorities using a sound strategy that combines principled thinking, research, and data

- You leverage tools and processes to build operational excellence into your product process

- You have a strong business sense and understand how product and GTM should collaborate, how your features may be monetized, and how product priorities fit into larger business priorities


### You may not be a great fit if

- You prefer to specify exactly what Engineering should build rather than give engineers room to own the solution.

- You dislike written documentation and prefer to manage the team via meetings and quick Slack messages.

- You’re primarily interested in shipping features and not thinking through how to make them reusable platform capabilities.

- You don’t enjoy doing deep research yourself and prefer to outsource that UX research, market research, and data teams.

- You’re uncomfortable moving with urgency, making tradeoffs, and reprioritizing when new information emerges.

- You’re primarily motivated by achieving a metric more than delivering a great product experience for customers.


## **We Work Differently**

At Ashby, the role of Product Managers is different from what I’ve seen in most product orgs. At a high level, PMs are responsible for shipping impactful product changes at high velocity, consistently and over an extended period. When we think about impactful product changes, our primary goal is to remove frustration and add delight.

At many organizations, PMs are required to write detailed specs that handle every edge case. Designers are required to mock up every pixel. At Ashby, it’s different. We believe individual contributors do their best work when they have a deep understanding of the end user and the business, and ownership of the solution. This is reflected in the engineers Ashby hires: they own projects end-to-end and deeply understand the problems they are solving. PMs are expected to give significant white space in their specs. As a result, PMs can spend less time managing tickets and more time with customers and thinking deeply about the product strategy.

At Ashby, PMs need to be the pace-setters for their product areas. This means they bring a healthy level of impatience and time-paranoia to the table. This does not mean cutting corners or demanding that engineers work unreasonable hours. As a PM, you can help engineers by managing the project scope well, identifying when it’s appropriate to bring in help, or being ruthless about prioritization.

For PM roles at Ashby, we believe great products are built through deep thinking and a clear understanding of user needs. A major part of your role involves conducting thorough user research to uncover underlying customer problems and translating those insights into well-reasoned product strategies.

Finally, Ashby isn’t simply an ATS. Right from the foundations, it was designed to be much more than that. It’s a platform modelled around how organizations (from early-stage startups to massive enterprises) think about recruiting, managing, and retaining top talent. As a PM at Ashby, you should, over time, get familiar with our most common building blocks. You’ll invest not only in product improvements but in platform thinking.

## **Interview Process**

If this also sounds exciting to you, please apply. We review every application and aim to get back to candidates within 2-3 days. For candidates that advance to the interview process, here is what you can expect:

1. **Intro Cal** l - 30 mins

2. **Product Experience Deep Dive**\- 45 mins

3. **Product Exercise** \- 1 hour

4. **Final Round Interview** \- 2 hours

 Mostly focused on cross-functional Interviews to meet more of the team. This is a critical hire for us and a role that will touch a lot of functions - we want to make sure you'll meet folks you'll be working closely with


## **Benefits**

- 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

- Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.

- Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

- Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

- $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

- $250/month tool budget plus access to Claude, Cursor, and Codex with generous token budgets.

- If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, which is also fully covered by us.


Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

**About MediaRadar**

MediaRadar powers the mission-critical marketing and sales decisions that drive competitive advantage. Our competitive advertising intelligence platform enables clients to achieve peak performance with always-on data and insights that span the media, creative, and business strategies of five million brands across 30+ media channels. By bringing the advertising past, present, and future into focus, our clients rapidly act on the competitive moves and emerging advertising trends impacting their business.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our Product Management organization and develop and own the product strategy around how media is priced, bought, and transacted. Our Publisher & Ad Tech clients increasingly look to us to help navigate the increasingly fragmented and complex media landscape across diverging media channels, buy types, transaction offerings, and pricing. To deliver on these needs, you will need to become an expert on customer use cases mapped to user personas and translate those into an actionable roadmap that aligns with MediaRadar’s larger strategic plan and product investments.

**Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities (What You’ll Do)**

- Set and sustain a customer-centric media pricing, buying, and transacting product strategy and roadmap in partnership with customers, commercial teams, Product counterparts, and Engineering.
- Prove out hypotheses and concepts with rapid prototyping, market research, and direct luminary customer feedback.
- Lead execution through sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily scrums, and sprint reviews to ensure on-time and quality delivery through strong agile SDLC framework discipline.
- Maximize engineering and design team value delivery through clear and user-centric product requirements and new methods of requirements delivery with AI.
- Assess, validate, communicate, and deliver on customer feedback to determine strategic alignment, appropriately manage expectations, and adapt the product roadmap.
- Drive proactive go-to-market by developing client-facing documentation, demos, positioning statements / talk tracks, and commercial enablement resources in concert with Product Marketing.
- Engage with MediaRadar’s executive leadership team to share progress, learnings, and build support for continued investment.

**Qualifications (What You’ve Done)**

- 3+ years of experience in Product Management in SaaS and/or data-oriented subject matter within the advertising, media, or marketing/ad tech industries.
- Demonstrated success shipping product that has delivered quantifiable business value.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving aptitude with the proven ability to synthesize varying sets of quantitative and qualitative data into data-backed decisions.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills – and your presentations are tailored to your audiences with the appropriate level of detail to land your message.
- Familiarity with agile management tools (e.g., Jira), user design tools (e.g., Figma Make, Lovable), and analytics tools (e.g., Looker).
- Differentiated qualifications include a career of multi-disciplined experiences (Product, GTM, Commercial, Operations, Technology) and industries.

- 401k with Company Match
- Flexible PTO
- Commuter Benefits
- Gym Discounts
- Summer Fridays

# Senior Product Manager, Discourse Graphs

$110k - $195k

Full-time

Astera Institute

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4227396959938202067?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4458071417638880107&crId=US_0US_0)

We are looking for a senior product manager to join the Discourse Graphs team, in a fully remote, fixed-term role of 12 to 18 months, paying $110,000 to $195,000 a year depending on where you are based.

Discourse Graphs is an open-source project that helps research teams write down, link and share their questions, claims and evidence, through plugins for Roam Research and Obsidian backed by a shared database. It is philanthropically funded and built by a small team across North America, Europe and India, together with the labs who pilot the tools with us.

## What you'll be doing

You'll join a small and friendly distributed team of engineers, designers and researchers who are designing, building, and testing new ways of doing collaborative science. We do most of our work in writing, across many time zones, and there are no managers: engineers pull their own work from a queue, and we judge progress by what researchers do with the tools rather than by targets. We are moving from asynchronous toward pair programming, short iterations and regular retrospectives.

This role will place you in a central node of a product that is evolving with its researcher user base. We have extensive feedback from internal use as well as two years of user pilots with research labs across North America, more ideas than we can act on, a growing community of labs, and funding to do something with both. You'll shape the product strategy, working out with the founders where Discourse Graphs should go, what to prioritize, and how to get there.

Some of the questions we are considering include whether the product stays a set of plugins in Obsidian or needs a standalone app now, how it will live in researchers’ existing tools such as agentic coding interfaces, and when we will extend our use cases to adjacent areas like publication overlays and institutional research roadmapping. We’ll follow where users’ interest is strongest, while making sure the work they depend on comes first.

Much of the work is hands-on, since there is no product team under you. Week to week you'll talk with the researchers who use the tools, turn what you hear into one ordered queue of work together with the designer and developers, and show your ideas as working prototypes as often as you write them up. You’ll be able to rate priority based on user need and our product vision. Engineers choose their own work from that queue, so we won't ask you to assign tasks, run sprints or act as a Scrum Master.

## About you

You are drawn to the problem of how research gets documented, connected and built upon, and you'd like to spend a year or more making that easier for working scientists. You are comfortable synthesizing diverse user needs and feedback into a set of high-level priorities and concrete prototypes. Your design instinct centers usability and meeting users within their existing workflows. You like to put something early-stage in front of people and change course based on what you see, and you are at ease guiding a team as a team member. You're likely to do well in this role if you have:

- Comfort soliciting and navigating user input in context of documented user flows

- A habit of talking with users every week, and of showing ideas as prototypes

- A way of working alongside designers and engineers rather than handing work to them

- Experience working without a manager: noticing what needs doing, taking it on, and keeping others posted in writing


## Our offer

The post is full-time for 12 to 18 months, either as a temporary employee of the Astera Institute or on contract at the same annual rate. It is fixed-term because our funding is, and we will be open about where the funding stands for as long as you are with us. It is fully remote, with some overlap with North American working hours, and you can also work in person at Astera in Emeryville, California. We'd like you to start as soon as you can. Pay is $110,000 to $195,000 a year, depending on where you are based. We also offer:

- A flexible approach to working hours and remote working

- Astera-sponsored health, vision and dental benefits for employees

- Onboarding help from peer product teams


We are an equal opportunity employer and are invested in fostering a culture where everyone can thrive. We are committed to equity and inclusion, and we encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, older members of society, and others from minority communities and diverse backgrounds to apply.

## How we hire

We start with a 30-minute call to get to know each other, with the last ten minutes for your questions. Next is a working session of up to 90 minutes with two of us on a real piece of our product work, in place of a take-home task. After that you'll talk with the founders about where you think the product should go, and finally we'll ask for two references, from an engineer and a designer you have worked with.

## To apply

Please apply through the form below. Along with your CV, we'll ask for a short note about a time something a user told you changed your product's direction, a description of your previous work in this area, and a link to something that shows how you think about product direction, such as a strategy write-up, a talk, a post or a prototype you built. We'll also ask about your availability, and whether you would prefer employment or a contract. We will start reviewing applications November 2. # Senior Product Manager, OR Solutions

Full-time

Artisight

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8047381111691658306?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=186&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8725918943188110705&crId=US_0US_0)

#### About Artisight Artisight transforms hospital operations with its Smart Hospital Platform, helping health systems reduce costs, improve efficiency, and enhance patient care. Guided by deep clinical expertise and powered by NVIDIA GPUs, Artisight’s voice-activated sensors and computer vision technology enable real-time observation, virtual nursing, and automated documentation directly in the EHR. The platform integrates seamlessly with existing workflows to reduce staff burden, accelerate patient throughput, and improve safety. More than 400 hospitals across 30 health systems trust Artisight to deliver measurable results, including cutting patient falls by over 50%, reducing nurse turnover, and saving millions annually.

### About the Role

Artisight’s smart room platform is live in operating rooms across a growing set of health systems, and our OR business is growing faster than our ability to deliver it repeatably. No one owns the OR as a product today. We’re seeking a **Senior Product Manager, Operating Room Solutions** to build that from the ground up: taking everything Artisight does and packaging it into a coherent, repeatable OR offering that our commercial team can sell, deploy, and expand. In this role, you’ll work on the ground alongside our clinical OR lead, earn the trust of OR directors, surgeons, and nursing staff, and translate what you learn into a product line with clear ROI and a roadmap that reflects what actually happens in the room.

**This role is remote, based in the U.S., and requires U.S. work authorization. Travel up to 50% is expected.**

### **What You’ll Do**

- Own site delivery for OR accounts: lead discovery, define go-live criteria, and hold the team to it
- Build and maintain the OR product offering: what’s in the package, what phases in later, and what we say no to
- Convert field observation and client requests into written, evidenced, ranked requirements and drive them into the roadmap through engineering product managers
- Develop the assets that make each site faster than the last: discovery scripts, workflow documentation, camera layout patterns, validation protocols, and sales enablement material
- Partner with Sales and Solution Engineering on OR opportunities, pilot scoping, and what a site needs in place before we commit
- Advocate for OR-specific features on the product roadmap, reporting to and partnering with engineering PM leadership to prioritize what gets built and when
- Represent the OR persona across the main application roadmap, ensuring the offering holds together regardless of site of care

### **What You Have**

- Deep, hands-on operating room experience; you can hold your own with an OR director, a charge nurse, and a surgeon in the same conversation
- 5+ years in product management, solutions, or a client-facing product role with a track record of being the person in the room with the customer
- Experience taking a technology capability to market in a clinical setting: packaging it, proving it, and getting it adopted
- Strong written communication skills; requirements, specs, discovery findings, and enablement material are core outputs of this role
- Comfort with data: able to look at case event data, spot what doesn’t make sense, and reason about why
- Comfort being the person in the room who earns trust quickly; OR staff are experienced with vendors competing for their time and attention
- Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%; much of this job does not happen over video

### Bonus Points For

- Clinical background in a perioperative role (RN, surgical technologist, CST)
- Experience with perioperative systems: EHR surgical modules, scheduling and case management, anesthesia information systems, or OR analytics platforms
- Familiarity with HL7 and how surgical case data moves between systems
- Prior work at a health technology vendor deploying into live clinical environments
- Experience standing up a new product line or market segment

### **Why You’ll Enjoy This Role**

- **Impact:** Every new OR site today is carried by a small number of people improvising. Your work turns that into a playbook, making each deployment faster and more predictable than the last
- **Growth:** You’ll develop deep expertise across perioperative operations, clinical AI deployment, and product strategy in one of healthcare’s most complex and high-stakes environments
- **Team:** You’ll work alongside our clinical OR lead and partner closely with engineering, sales, clinical services, and perioperative leadership at health system clients

**Interview Process (all calls conducted via video):**

- Recruiter Interview - 30 minutes
- Hiring Manager Interview - 30 to 45 minutes
- Cross-Team Interview - 30 minutes
- Case Study - 60 minutes
