# Senior Product Manager, Forward Deployed - US

Full-time

CertifyOS

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2601799811912676177?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6251580485780184431&crId=US_0US_0)

**About CertifyOS**

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.

Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.

Our vision is simple: **One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.**

We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.

## **About the Role**

We’re hiring a Forward Deployed Product Manager to discover, build, and scale new businesses at Certify. You will work closely with Sales and customers to find valuable problems we are well positioned to solve, rapidly prototype solutions, and turn the strongest opportunities into products customers buy and use.

Certify’s provider data infrastructure and customer relationships give you a foundation for building new offerings. AI and agentic systems expand what is possible: you can explore a customer’s workflow, put a working prototype in their hands, and test an idea at a pace that would have been difficult even a year ago. You will help determine where that speed can create a lasting business advantage.

You’ll be deep in the context with our customers and have strong start points from our sales and partnership teams. That means joining discovery and sales conversations, observing operational workflows, building and iterating prototypes, and staying involved through delivery and adoption. You will connect those experiences to business decisions about whom we serve, what we offer, how we price it, and where we invest.

This is a role for someone with strong product judgment, practical fluency in agentic AI, and the instincts of a business builder. You should be as comfortable prototyping with a customer as you are challenging a business case or partnering with Engineering to turn an early solution into an enterprise grade product.

## **What You Will Do**

### **Find and validate new businesses**

- Partner closely with Sales, Business Development, and customers to identify emerging opportunities. Understand the user’s problem, the buyer’s priorities, and where Certify’s data and platform give us an advantage.

- Develop a clear point of view on which opportunities to pursue. Test willingness to pay, market demand, pricing, cost to serve, and the potential to expand beyond the first customer.

- Define what must be learned before increasing investment. Make thoughtful decisions about which ideas to iterate, scale, or stop, and communicate the reasoning clearly.

- Partner with existing product teams where this creates leverage and accelerates the business


### **Prototype and learn with customers**

- Work directly with customers to understand how work gets done, including the exceptions and manual steps that shape their day. Translate that understanding into solutions they can try.

- Use AI coding tools and agentic systems to build working prototypes quickly. Iterate in live customer conversations and test the workflow with realistic data and clear measures of value.

- Partner with Sales to make new offerings tangible through demonstrations and early customer engagements. Align on scope, success criteria, and delivery commitments so we can move quickly and earn customer trust.


### **Deliver and scale what works**

- Stay accountable from the first experiment through delivery, adoption, and expansion. Work with Engineering, Design, Operations, and Client Success to turn validated ideas into products we can support and sell repeatedly.

- Make clear tradeoffs between the needs of an early customer and a broader product opportunity. Identify what should become a reusable capability and where a tailored solution makes commercial sense.

- Bring technical judgment to agentic products, including tool and API integration, evaluations, human review, permissions, and failure handling. Partner with Engineering to establish the quality needed for production use.

- Shape the offering and launch with our commercial teams, including positioning, packaging, pricing, and a repeatable approach to implementation. Help the field understand who the product is for and how to demonstrate its value.

- Measure customer value and business results, including adoption, time saved, operational quality, revenue, expansion, and margin. Use those results to guide the next investment.


## **About You**

- You love building products and businesses. You have taken an ambiguous opportunity from discovery to a shipped product and can explain what customers gained and how the business benefited.

- You have 5+ years of product management experience, or founder experience with comparable ownership, in SaaS, healthtech, or another complex software business.

- You are practically fluent in AI and agentic systems. You use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to build and test ideas, and have examples of working prototypes or products you helped deliver.

- You earn trust with customers and Sales, ask sharp questions, and bring an independent product perspective. You know how to support a commercial opportunity while making sound product and investment decisions.

- You bring clarity to complex situations and work well with engineers. You can move between a customer conversation, workflow details, technical tradeoffs, and a business case.

- You are curious, experimental, and comfortable with uncertainty. You learn quickly, act on feedback, and follow through on the details that make a product useful and a business viable.


### **Experience that would help**

- Launching new paid offerings, working with early customers, or building businesses that combine software and operational services.

- Healthcare technology, provider data, or regulated enterprise workflows; experience deploying AI agents or automation into real customer operations.


**Benefits of Working at Certify**

- At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.

- Your well-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge. In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.


We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

# Senior Product Manager, Authorization Optimization

$145k - $205k

Full-time

Signifyd

At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

### About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our authorization optimization product area, where payments and fraud decisioning meet. You will own authorization rate improvement for legitimate transactions. Set the strategy, prioritize the highest-value opportunities, and drive delivery across existing capability teams.

This is a hands-on, technical product role. You will translate strategy into precise requirements, define the data and API interfaces that connect us with merchants, payment service providers and issuers, and be the product voice in architecture discussions. You will work daily with engineering and data science, and alongside go-to-market teams who bring the product to merchants.

### What you'll do

- Own the authorization optimization roadmap end to end: set priorities, sequence delivery, make tradeoffs, and communicate the plan and its rationale to leadership, engineering and go-to-market teams.
- Determine where Signifyd should build, orchestrate, partner or influence issuers directly, informed by issuer behavior, merchant needs and regional payment dynamics.
- Write detailed technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria, and manage the backlog with engineering.
- Define and evolve the APIs, data models and integration points through which authorization and decline data flows between merchants, PSPs, issuers and our platform.
- Identify, evaluate and develop new partnerships (such as PSPs, gateways, acquirers, issuers and data or technology providers) that expand our coverage and deliver measurable value to merchants.
- Build issuer/BIN intelligence covering authorization performance, decline patterns and treatment effectiveness. Maintain a quantified opportunity map to prioritize recoverable revenue.
- Drive issuer-specific decisioning across step-ups, 3DS, decline recovery and intelligent retries; inform routing where merchants have multiple PSP or acquirer options.
- Work with data science to define requirements for risk-aware decisioning, balancing approval gains against fraud and chargeback exposure.
- Own measurable authorization uplift and recovered merchant revenue. Demonstrate treatment impact through merchant proofs of value and issuer/BIN-level reporting.
- Partner with sales, solutions and customer success to bring merchant feedback into the roadmap and support adoption.
- Stay current on card network rules, regulation and industry practice, and use that knowledge to sharpen requirements.

### What you'll bring (required)

- 5+ years in a product management role, including ownership of a roadmap and end-to-end delivery.
- Hands-on payments product experience spanning issuer authorization behavior, with a deep understanding of decline recovery and retries, 3DS, PSD2/SCA frameworks (including the upcoming transition to PSD3/PSR), and demonstrated improvements in authorization performance.
- Experience writing detailed technical specs and defining APIs or data interfaces in partnership with engineering (backend or high-volume transaction systems a plus).
- Strong analytical skills, with comfort working from transaction-level data and defining success metrics.
- Experience working closely with data science or analytics teams and translating insights into product requirements.
- Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
- Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.

### Preferred

- Experience at a payment processor, PSP, acquirer, card network, issuer or fraud/risk vendor.
- Exposure to fraud, risk or digital identity products, including the false-decline versus fraud-loss tradeoff.
- Experience defining requirements for ML-driven decisioning.
- Familiarity with 3DS/EMVCo, tokenization, ISO 8583 and PSD2/SCA.
- B2B SaaS or enterprise e-commerce merchant experience.

**Senior Product Manager, Ticketing - Resale/Secondary Marketplace**

Remote (East Coast preferred) \| Contract-to-Hire

**Overview**

We're the official marketplace for some of the world's most iconic live events. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead our resale and secondary marketplace product for large-scale US based sporting events

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of consumer experience, partner integrations, and live event commerce. You'll own the product vision and execution for our resale business

We're moving fast - ideally looking to have someone in the seat in the immediate timeframe.

**What You'll Own**

- Lead product strategy and execution for our resale/secondary marketplace
- Drive consumer-facing resale experiences across web and mobile, with a focus on conversion and engagement
- Own the resale product roadmap for our NFL partnership and the LA 2028 Olympics hospitality platform
- Define and ship features that improve inventory ranking, pricing, and discovery
- Partner closely with engineering, design, and data teams to deliver high-quality product at pace
- Work with API integrations across ticketing supply partners and distribution channels
- Identify and build AI-powered product capabilities to improve buyer and seller experiences

**Required Qualifications**

- **5+ years of product management experience in consumer-facing ticketing, with deep expertise in secondary/resale marketplaces**
- Hands-on experience at one or more of major secondary ticketing companies
- Strong technical aptitude - you've worked directly with engineering teams, understand APIs, and can go deep on system design tradeoffs
- Experience building or shipping AI-powered product features
- B2C product background with a proven track record driving revenue through resale marketplace optimization
- East Coast based (or willing to operate on East Coast hours)
- Startup mentality: bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and ability to move fast with limited resources

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Background in UX or user experience design
- Role would not be launching a net new product, but driving/facilitating existing secondary ticketing products
- Track record of driving revenue through inventory curation, merchandising, or pricing strategies

##### Senior Product Manager

At ThrivePass, we're on a mission to help employees and businesses Thrive—because benefits should be more than just checkboxes. Through personalized benefits technology, data-driven insights, and meaningful experiences, we empower companies to support their teams in ways that truly matter. We don't just talk about culture—we build it. Everything we do is rooted in our CARE values:

- Courageous – We embrace new challenges and fresh ideas.
- Authentic – We show up as our true selves and value transparency.
- Resourceful – We find creative solutions and make things happen.
- Excellent – We hold ourselves accountable and take pride in our work.

At ThrivePass, performance isn't just about hitting goals—it's about how you show up. We invest in our employees' growth and encourage bold thinking, collaboration, and continuous learning. Join us in shaping the future of employee benefits!

What You'll Do As a Senior Product Manager, you'll play a key role within the Product team, contributing to the strategy, scalability, and performance of the ThrivePass platform. Your work will help shape both internal and external customer experiences, drive innovation, and build operational excellence.

You will:

- Bring fresh ideas to the table. We're all about innovation and continuous improvement.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align priorities and drive outcomes.
- Own and evolve the product roadmap in alignment with department strategy and company goals.
- Define and drive platform strategy, planning, delivery, and optimization by establishing and monitoring success metrics.
- Gather customer feedback and market insights to translate business needs into actionable product requirements.
- Prioritize and manage the product backlog with a focus on adoption, performance, reliability, and scalability.
- Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and support product documentation, release notes, and enablement materials.

What You Bring We're looking for someone who's not just checking boxes but is genuinely excited to make an impact.

- A drive to innovate within employee benefits and simplify complex processes.
- A collaborative, team-first mindset.
- Accountability and ownership. You set clear expectations and follow through.
- Comfort navigating ambiguity and creating clarity in evolving environments.
- A customer-centric approach with a passion for usability and accessibility.

Must Haves

- 4-6 years of experience managing and launching software products from concept to delivery.
- Experience working in Agile product development environments and leading cross-functional initiatives.
- Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills supported by customer insights and product metrics.
- Ability to balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility when prioritizing work.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex information into clear action plans.

Nice to Have

- Experience in the employee benefits, HR technology, fintech, or healthcare technology industries.
- Familiarity with SaaS platforms and scaling customer-facing products.
- Experience working with product analytics, experimentation, and performance measurement frameworks.
- Strong stakeholder management and influence skills across technical and non-technical teams.
- Passion for building innovative, high-impact solutions that improve customer experiences.

Why You'll Love Working Here We're an inclusive and welcoming environment for all. ThrivePass is committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We do not and shall not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status in any of our activities or operations.

- A culture that values courageousness, authenticity, resourcefulness, and excellence (we don't just say it—we live it).
- Opportunities to grow, learn, and level up your skills.
- A team that genuinely enjoys working together and celebrating wins.
- Competitive benefits package because we believe in walking the talk when it comes to employee well-being.

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

### Senior Product Manager, Athena

Chainguard secures the open source supply chain—the infrastructure underneath the majority of software running in production today. This team is building Athena, the system that makes that possible at enterprise scale. Learn more about Athena.

Athena processes vulnerability reports from enterprise customers, validates and deduplicates findings, and routes clean signals to remediation. We are building the clearing house between our customers and Chainguard’s remediation engine.

As Senior Product Manager, you will own the Athena member experience end to end—from vulnerability intake and submission through validation, remediation, and the delivery of patches and advisories. Your scope will span private feeds, the Chainguard Console, documentation, and customer-facing operations. Rather than owning a single feature, you will bring together multiple teams and related product areas to create a cohesive, scalable member experience.

This is a highly cross-functional role for a product leader who understands deeply technical enterprise customers, can create clarity from noisy input, and is comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving security environment.

**What you’ll do**

- Own the end-to-end Athena member workflow and strategy: Define the product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for the member experience, from intake and validation through status visibility, remediation, and how patches and advisories appear in OSV and VEX feeds, private feeds, the registry, console, and documentation.

- Be the primary product voice: Represent Athena internally and with customers on scope, capabilities, and direction, and educate customer-facing teams so they can communicate clearly and credibly.

- Turn field input into a prioritized backlog: Identify systemic gaps across the member workflow, convert recurring questions, feedback, and feature requests into clear problem statements, and maintain a well-written, prioritized backlog.

- Lead cross-functional delivery and technical tradeoffs: Align roadmaps and ownership across Engineering, remediation, Documentation, Customer Success, and other partners; work with Engineering on data validation, workflow routing, entitlements, access controls, and reliability; and partner with remediation on patch delivery, including disclosure readiness, SBOMs and provenance, breaking changes, and capacity tradeoffs.

- Measure, flag risks, and mentor: Define and report member-experience metrics (submission volume and coverage, time to patch, status visibility, feed adoption), raise customer, delivery, and business risks early (especially around disclosure cycles), and serve as a trusted partner and mentor to product peers.


**What we’re looking for**

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a technical B2B product serving enterprise customers in regulated industries; financial-services experience is strongly preferred. Working fluency in software supply chain security, including CVEs, OSV, VEX, SBOMs, provenance, and vulnerability disclosure.

- Experience leading complex initiatives across multiple engineering and business teams without relying on direct authority.

- Strong judgment when balancing customer urgency, disclosure timelines, technical constraints, and broader business priorities.

- Comfort operating with high independence across multiple related problem spaces in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trust with technical teams, customer-facing partners, executives, and enterprise customers.


**Explore Our Work**

Dive into the practical side of what we do at Chainguard. These resources provide a hands-on look at our processes and offer an opportunity for in-depth understanding of our product offerings and the technology behind them.

##### Senior Product Manager

Kaseya is seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly customer-focused Senior Product Manager responsible for defining and supporting the building of desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet customer needs within our Professional Services Automation (PSA) module - the operational backbone for Managed Service Providers.

As a senior individual contributor, the Senior Product Manager will partner closely with cross-functional teams, executive leadership and fellow PSA Product Managers to execute on the Product Vision, Roadmap, and Features required to address the evolving needs of MSPs and IT professionals in our IT Service Delivery pillar. This role requires strong technical acumen, exceptional business judgment, and a proven track record of delivering successful SaaS products at scale.

Key Responsibilities

- Contribute to the strategic planning process and ensure continuing alignment of the product strategy with the overall company strategy.
- Define, prioritize and execute on product roadmaps aligned with Kaseya's corporate objectives.
- Translate customer and business requirements into clear product specifications, user stories, and prioritization frameworks.
- Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing solutions.
- Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to support go-to-market planning, product positioning, and customer adoption.
- Track and monitor metrics and KPIs to evaluate product success and drive continuous improvement.
- Identify market opportunities through customer engagement, competitive analysis, industry trends, and data-driven insights.
- Serve as a product thought leader internally and externally through customer engagements, conferences, and strategic partner discussions.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 5+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 2 years in the MSP industry or in B2B SaaS tools used by MSPs.
- Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies and software development lifecycles.
- Demonstrated success launching and scaling complex SaaS, cloud, enterprise software, or technology products.
- Experience in IT management, cybersecurity, MSP, automation, or enterprise technology solutions.
- Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience using data and customer insights to drive product decisions and business outcomes.
- Product Management certifications (CSPO, Pragmatic Institute, Product School, or equivalent) a bonus.

PreVeil

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1737929909969923583?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3140593945684793097&crId=US_0US_0)

**About the Company**

PreVeil is a fast-growing tech company transforming secure communication and compliance for the modern enterprise. Our encrypted email and file sharing platform combines end-to-end encryption with a simple user experience and has been named PC Magazine's Best Encrypted Email and File Sharing Solution five years running.

Trusted by more than 3,000 defense contractors, PreVeil has become the gold standard for protecting sensitive information and achieving compliance efficiently. We're profitable, growing 100% year-over-year, and building for the long term.

**About the Role**

PreVeil is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own core product strategy, drive execution, and build exceptional user experiences across our portfolio. You'll sit at the intersection of customer insight, product excellence, and business goals-defining what we build, why we build it, and how we ship it with speed and impact. Think like an owner: every feature is an investment, every problem demands first-principles rigor, and you're constantly prioritizing resources to deliver maximum value to users and the business.

This is a high-ownership role on a lean, fast-moving team empowered to solve hard product problems. You'll move fast, dig deep to uncover real root causes, and rally engineering, design, and go-to-market teams around a clear, compelling vision. You won't be doing it alone. You'll collaborate closely with top-tier engineers, designers, and company leaders dedicated to building the future of secure and compliant communication and collaboration for the enterprise.

**Product Judgment & Strategic Thinking**

• Evaluate competing approaches rigorously, form a clear and well-reasoned point of view, and articulate tradeoffs with conviction

• Define and own the product roadmap for your area - set direction, prioritize ruthlessly, and align the team around what matters most and why

• Operate at both the strategic and tactical level: think in years, execute in weeks

**First Principles & Root Cause Thinking**

• Dig beneath the surface of customer feedback and product problems to find the real underlying need, constraint, or opportunity

• Relentlessly ask why until you understand what's actually true - not just what's visible or what's been assumed

• Reason from fundamentals to reach better conclusions faster, especially in ambiguous or novel situations

**Pattern Recognition & Connecting the Dots**

• Spot connections others miss - draw on a broad base of experience to recognize when a new problem rhymes with an old one

• Connect signals across customers, market trends, and product gaps to form insight faster than the data alone would suggest

• Synthesize across disparate inputs - user research, eng constraints, competitive dynamics, business goals - into a coherent picture

**Deep Customer & Market Understanding**

• Develop a genuine, granular understanding of how customers think, work, and struggle - not just what they ask for

• Build relationships with customers directly; bring the voice of the user into every product decision

• Stay ahead of market trends and competitive dynamics to inform strategy and identify opportunities

**Systems Thinking**

• Understand how different parts of the product connect and affect each other - design solutions that work across the whole, not just the immediate problem

• Anticipate second-order effects of product decisions on users, engineering, and the business

• Hold the full product architecture in mind while working on specific problems

**Execution & Delivery Rigor**

• Drive initiatives from discovery through launch with focus, discipline, and follow-through

• Break down complex problems into clear MVPs and iterative steps that ship with velocity and impact

• Be the kind of PM engineering and design can build with confidently - reliable, unblocking, and always moving things forward

**Leadership, Motivation & Collaboration**

• Lead and motivate without formal authority - earn trust and followership through clarity of vision, genuine respect, and consistency

• Keep the team aligned and energized through ambiguity, setbacks, and competing priorities

• Partner closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market as a true peer - not a ticket writer or gatekeeper

**Communication & Written Clarity**

**We Breathe Life Into Data**

At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease.

As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way.

**The Opportunity at Komodo Health:**

Komodo Health is reimagining how revenue operations runs. We’re moving beyond a static SaaS stack to an AI-centric model where intelligent systems support sellers and operations teams by handling rote work and surfacing the right action at the right moment.

As Senior Product Manager, you will sit at the intersection of revenue operations, technology, and applied AI. You will lead discussions with GTM, Legal, and Finance teams to understand their processes and pain points, then turn those requirements into a prioritized roadmap and working solutions, shipped in partnership with our developers. Over time, you will own our go-to-market product and be trusted to push back on senior leaders when priorities need challenging. If you’ve used AI to deliver measurable productivity gains, or you’re eager to, this is a role where you can do it at scale.

**What You'll Do:**

- Establish a prioritized go-to-market product roadmap, agreed to by Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive leadership, with a clear intake and prioritization process the team runs after you.
- Simplify the go-to-market technology stack by reducing redundant tools and manual handoffs, without disrupting revenue-critical workflows.
- Deliver major platform milestones with Engineering on agreed timelines, with clear success criteria for each.
- Set baselines early, then show measurable gains in time saved, cycle time, data quality, and user adoption.
- Build trusted partnerships with senior GTM leaders, where hard trade-off conversations lead to better decisions.

**Who You Are:**

- Own the roadmap: Set priorities for our go-to-market platform, balancing competing needs across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, and say no when the evidence calls for it.
- Partner with the business: Lead working sessions with GTM, Legal, and Finance stakeholders to map processes and friction across lead management, pipeline, forecasting, quoting, and order fulfillment.
- Translate requirements into solutions: Turn business needs into clear specs, and prototype where it helps, then work with developers to ship and scale them.
- Apply AI to real work: Use AI to automate rote tasks and give sellers and operations users more time, and measure the impact.
- Manage the tool and integration portfolio: Make build-versus-buy calls, evaluate vendors, and retire what we no longer need.
- Drive adoption: Lead rollouts and change management with the Revenue Operations and Enablement Team so new workflows stick.
- Influence senior leaders: Make trade-offs visible and push back constructively on executives when priorities need challenging.

**What you bring to Komodo Health:**

- 5+ years owning roadmaps and prioritization for complex systems or platforms, with a track record of shipping alongside engineering teams.
- Working knowledge of how revenue teams operate across lead management, account and territory management, pipeline and forecasting, quoting, and order fulfillment, gained in a product, RevOps, GTM systems, or systems integration role.
- Experience evaluating, implementing, or owning GTM technology (CRM, CPQ, sales and marketing platforms) and making build-versus-buy decisions.
- Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate work or improve team productivity, with results you can describe in measurable terms.
- Solid grounding in data management and BI tools, with the ability to define success metrics and track them.
- Ability to lead conversations with senior Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success leaders and to push back constructively when priorities need challenging.

**Additional skills we'd prioritize...**

- Hands-on experience building or shipping with AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code), whether prototypes, internal tools, or production code.
- Experience with integration or orchestration platforms (e.g., Workato).
- Experience leading a system migration or replatforming effort.

##### Senior Product Manager

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn't just growth; it's a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren't just building another tool; we're defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll play a critical role in shaping and driving UpGuard's product strategy. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful features, ensuring our solutions address real customer problems and deliver measurable value. This role is ideal for someone passionate about building customer-first products, with a strong blend of strategic thinking, technical acumen, and design sensibility.

Define and own the strategic vision and roadmap for key areas of the UpGuard platform, guiding initiatives from discovery through delivery while ensuring long-term impact and alignment with business goals.

Partner with Engineering, Design, and other stakeholders to define, build, and launch products that delight customers and align with business objectives.

Translate customer problems and opportunities into clear, actionable product requirements.

Collaborate with Design to craft thoughtful, intuitive user experiences and maintain design consistency across the platform.

Balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints to prioritise the most impactful work.

Champion a customer-first mindset—deeply understanding user pain points and advocating for meaningful solutions.

Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress effectively to stakeholders across all levels.

Analyse performance metrics to measure success and identify areas for improvement.

Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and iteration.

Proven experience as a Product Manager or Senior Product Manager, ideally in a SaaS or technology-driven environment.

Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Sales).

Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Demonstrated ability to define and drive complex product initiatives.

Experience in UX or design collaboration.

Strong understanding of data and metrics to inform product decisions.

Previous experience or qualifications in security or compliance.

Exposure to security and/or GRC teams, risk assessment, compliance and audit processes.

A background or strong interest in design thinking and user experience.

Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts and solutions.

Experience with integrations, APIs, or data-driven product development.

A track record of identifying and seizing commercial opportunities within product strategies.

##### Senior Product Manager

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage. Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.

Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.

Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

How You'll Make A Big Impact Here – And On Your Career:

As a Senior Product Manager on the Versapay AR Automation team, you will act as the single accountable owner for a critical product area, responsible for delivering measurable business outcomes—not just features. You will lead the evolution of our AR platform into an AI-first, highly automated, and scalable system that drives meaningful improvements in cash flow, efficiency, and customer experience.

You will operate as a GM for your domain, owning strategy, execution, and commercial success. This includes defining what we build and why, validating opportunities through experimentation, and ensuring successful adoption and performance post-launch.

What You'll Do (Key Competencies):

- Own measurable business outcomes (adoption, revenue, unit economics, retention) and adjust strategy based on performance signals.
- Act as the single accountable owner for your product area, making decisions based on data, customer insight, and strategy—not stakeholder opinion.
- Operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging AI across discovery, prototyping, and product capabilities.
- Define and evolve product strategy with clear narratives, including customer problem, expected impact, assumptions, and risks.
- Own or influence product economics, including revenue performance, cost-to-serve, and monetization strategy.
- Drive end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery through commercialization, ensuring delivery translates into real business impact.
- Design and run structured experiments (concept tests, pilots, pricing tests) to validate opportunities before scaling.
- Continuously modernize your product, improving architecture, reducing technical debt, and adopting new technologies.
- Apply systems thinking to design scalable, end-to-end customer journeys across workflows, data, and platform components.
- Own go-to-market outcomes end-to-end, including positioning, enablement, adoption, and commercial success.
- Partner cross-functionally to drive alignment, influence decisions, and operationalize product changes.
- Drive towards self-serve, scalable product experiences that reduce operational friction.
- Synthesize customer insight, product data, and market signals to continuously refine priorities.
- Lead through influence in a complex environment, making clear decisions under ambiguity.
- Create clarity through strong written artifacts, decision frameworks, and communication.
- Foster a high-performance, low-ego culture grounded in accountability and collaboration.

What You'll Bring To The Team:

- 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B, fintech, or payments.
- Proven track record of owning and delivering measurable product outcomes.
- Experience building and scaling complex products, platforms, or APIs.
- Experience launching AI/ML products or features.
- Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate data into decisions.
- Experience designing and running experiments to validate product direction.
- Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with a bias toward action.
- Strong technical fluency and ability to partner deeply with engineering.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive audiences.
- Passion for customer problems and delivering meaningful, measurable value.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Nice to Have):

- Experience with AR, payments, or financial workflow automation.
- Experience applying AI/ML to product development or product capabilities.
- Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to design scalable solutions.
- Experience influencing pricing, packaging, or go-to-market strategies.
- Hands-on experience with product analytics or data tooling.

You will work with your product team, stakeholders, and customers to build our product across a large, nationwide network of clinicians. Your impact will not only be seen in the lives of the patients who receive timely and adequate care but also in the way our healthcare system operates by increasing digital connectivity across the system.

**Responsibilities**

_Product Strategy and Research_

- Work with current and potential partners to aid in customer research, business development, feedback collection, and product planning for your roadmap
- Define product release slices for Clinician experience that optimize for time to value
- Measure and analyze the product success/fail metrics in your product area and align them to our overall business goals

_Product Development Delivery_

- Align your balanced product team on a clear strategy and prioritize work in progress to maximize user outcomes, customer satisfaction and business growth
- Build artifacts that help unify the organization (roadmaps, product briefs, etc.)
- Supports your team through the product build and launch process
- Manage milestones and deliverables to maximize time to value
- Help define and measure success metrics
- Define methods for customer feedback loops
- Partner with Engineering and Design teams

_Adoption and Go-to-Market_

- Drive adoption and engagement across health systems and clinician practices. Partner with Customer Success, Implementation and Marketing to find friction in onboarding and ordering, and use what you learn from usage data to make Parachute the default way clinicians order HME
- Collaborate with marketing and operations to bring products to market

_Team and Stakeholder Collaboration_

- Work with customers and external stakeholders to develop solutions
- Collaborate with marketing and operations teams to develop and get products to market
- Coordinate across the organization, customers, and partners to articulate and execute product decisions

**Who You Are**

- Communication & Collaboration: An excellent communicator, presenting ideas clearly and succinctly, and highly collaborative, working with diverse stakeholders to create alignment around product vision and prioritization.
- Results-Oriented & Analytical: You can look at problems and create solutions from high-level goals that drive real business impact to ground-level execution. You are analytical, using data to clarify decisions wherever possible.
- Strategic & User-Focused: Great at prioritizing in a complex healthcare landscape. You are user-focused, empathetic, curious, and ask questions before offering solutions. You build the right thing, with a bias towards delivering customer value based on goals and metrics.
- Experienced: You have 7+ years of product management experience
- Ambiguity & Risk Management: You have past successes driving software products forward, ideally at a startup. You cut through ambiguity, comfortable taking calculated risks and making decisions under uncertainty.
- Travel **:** You are located within the United States and are willing to travel to customer sites and/or conferences (1-2 trips per quarter).

**Nice to Have**

- Bachelor’s Degree in a technical, scientific, or quantitative field, or equivalent experience
- A background in healthcare, and knowledge of healthcare complexity
- Experience with EHR integrations or healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR)
- Experience in a fast-paced startup environment

**Who You Aren’t**

- You're not a solo act. Our PMs lead by influence. They thrive in a team-based environment and believe in making decisions with broad input.
- You aren't someone who can only thrive in highly structured environments. We are a fast-paced startup where processes are still being defined and refined
- You're not simply a project manager or product owner.
- You aren't indifferent or dismissive of the perspectives of users, stakeholders, or team members.

**Benefits**

- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive plans with options for low-to-no-cost premiums.
- Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account.
- 401(k) Retirement Plan
- Equity Incentive Plan
- Annual Company-Wide Bonus: Opportunity for up to 15% bonus based on company performance.
- Remote-First Culture: We are remote-first with a dedicated NYC office and reimbursement options for co-working spaces.
- Flexible Vacation Policy
- Summer Fridays: 5 additional Fridays off during the summer (separate from PTO).
- Home Office and Wellness Stipend
- Monthly Internet Stipend
- Annual Learning and Development Stipend

Orchestry Software

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8745337674936570062?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5429346772407331016&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Product Manager

As a Senior Product Manager at Orchestry, you'll own meaningful areas of the product from discovery through launch and iteration. You'll spend time with customers, understand their problems deeply, turn those insights into product opportunities, work alongside Engineering and UX to shape solutions, and help determine what we build next and why.

This is a hands-on role. We're looking for someone who enjoys the actual craft of product management: talking to customers, digging through data, prototyping ideas, defining requirements, working through trade-offs with engineers, and measuring whether what we shipped actually worked. You'll also have significant autonomy. We want someone who develops a point of view, communicates it clearly, and moves things forward.

What you'll do:

- Own product areas end-to-end, from discovery and strategy through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
- Build strong relationships with customers and regularly participate in discovery calls, sales conversations, customer feedback sessions, and post-launch validation.
- Identify customer problems and opportunities through qualitative research, product data, market trends, competitive research, and input from Sales, Customer Success, and Support.
- Turn ambiguous problems into clear product direction, priorities, bets, requirements, prototypes, and measurable outcomes.
- Partner closely with Engineering and UX throughout discovery and delivery, bringing them into problems early rather than simply handing off requirements.
- Develop and maintain product roadmaps that connect customer needs with company strategy and measurable business outcomes.
- Prioritize competing opportunities using evidence, product judgment, business impact, technical feasibility, and strategic fit.
- Work closely with go-to-market teams so upcoming capabilities are understood, positioned, launched, and supported effectively.
- Establish success criteria before development and measure adoption, customer value, and business impact after launch.
- Challenge assumptions, including your own, and use customer evidence and data to help the team make better decisions.
- Help continuously improve how Product operates at Orchestry, including discovery, planning, communication, documentation, and delivery practices.
- Use modern AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, prototyping, analysis, and other parts of the product development lifecycle.
- Mentor and collaborate with other product team members as the organization continues to grow.

Qualifications:

- 6+ years of product management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, with demonstrated senior-level ownership of complex products or major product areas.
- Experience owning software products or major product areas through the full product lifecycle.
- Strong customer discovery skills and a genuine desire to spend time directly with customers.
- A track record of turning customer and market insights into successful product decisions.
- Strong product judgment and the confidence to form and defend a point of view.
- Comfortable making decisions in ambiguous environments without waiting for perfect information.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience working closely with software engineers and enough technical fluency to participate meaningfully in architecture, feasibility, API, integration, and implementation discussions.
- Strong analytical skills and experience using both quantitative and qualitative evidence to make product decisions.
- Experience defining product outcomes and measuring whether launches actually achieved them.
- Ability to work across Engineering, UX, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and leadership without relying on formal authority.
- Comfortable in a fast-moving startup or scale-up where roles are broad and priorities can evolve.
- A high degree of ownership. When you see a problem, your instinct is to understand it and help solve it.

Nice to Have's:

- Experience with enterprise SaaS, IT administration, security, governance, or platform products.
- Experience building products for technical or administrative users.
- Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Entra ID, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, or the broader Microsoft ecosystem.
- Experience with APIs, integrations, permissions, identity, or enterprise security concepts.
- Experience with AI-enabled products, LLMs, agents, MCP, or AI-assisted product development.
- Experience working with remote and distributed teams.
- Experience mentoring other Product Managers or helping improve a product management practice.

How We Work:

We believe good Product Management starts with understanding the problem, not defending a solution. Our PMs are expected to stay close to customers, collaborate deeply with Engineering, bring evidence into decisions, and have strong opinions while remaining willing to change those opinions when the evidence changes.

We move quickly, but we're not interested in shipping features simply to say we shipped them. We care about whether the work solves a real problem and creates measurable value. You'll have room to operate here. We expect you to use it.

What Success Looks Like:

- Developed a deep understanding of Orchestry's customers, market, product, and Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
- Taken clear ownership of meaningful areas of the product.
- Built trusted relationships with customers and internal teams.
- Helped turn customer problems into well-validated product investments.
- Improved the quality and consistency of how work moves from discovery into Engineering.
- Shipped meaningful capabilities and demonstrated whether they achieved the outcomes we expected.
- Become someone Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and leadership actively seek out when making product decisions.

##### Why Orchestry?

- Work that matters: Join a growing, remote-first SaaS company solving real problems for organizations navigating the complexity of Microsoft 365.
- Real ownership: Build and scale the revenue operations discipline from the ground up.
- Flexibility with accountability: We trust people to work in the way that works best for them while staying accountable for meaningful outcomes.
- A smart, kind, no-ego team: People show up, work across departments, and care more about getting to the right answer than being the person who had it first.
- Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits.

About Orchestry:

Orchestry is a pioneering SaaS company in the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, helping organizations simplify, govern, and get more value from their collaboration tools. Our platform empowers IT and business users alike through intelligent automation, governance, and user-friendly design.

We are a remote-first team of smart, kind, low-ego people who take ownership of their work and care about building something that matters. There is plenty of flexibility in how you work, but just as much accountability for what you deliver.

We're growing fast and scaling globally, and we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own meaningful areas of the product end-to-end—from discovery and strategy through launch and iteration. You'll spend time with customers, turn their insights into product opportunities, work closely with Engineering and UX to shape solutions, and help determine what we build next and why. This is a hands-on role with significant autonomy, where you'll develop a clear point of view, communicate it, and move things forward.

Drips

ABOUT DRIPS

Drips is a conversational AI platform that helps enterprise brands and their partners have smarter, more human conversations with customers, at scale. We operate at the intersection of AI, messaging, and revenue-generating outcomes for some of the largest companies in the country.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a dynamic Senior Product Manager to join our Product team. This is an individual contributor role, reporting directly to the VP of Product & Engineering, and you will work across every department, including Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, Sales, Data Analytics, and AI/ML.

This is a fully remote role, working with fully remote teams. Leading and influencing across departments in a distributed environment is a key experience to success in this role.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- End-to-end delivery of product initiatives across multiple domains simultaneously

- Writing clear, detailed PRDs and functional specs independently, utilizing AI-first workflows at every step along the way

- Customer and stakeholder discovery, translating messy real-world requirements into scoped, buildable features

- Owning relationships with external vendors and integration partners from evaluation through go-live

- Regular communication with exec leadership, including presenting roadmap and status updates with confidence and precision

- Working hands-on with AI and automation tooling to shape, validate, and accelerate product decisions, including defining requirements for LLM-based features and continually evolving your own workflows and tools to fit the problem in front of you

- Querying and evaluating data directly to inform decisions and validate outcomes

- Gaining consensus across Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and AI/ML without losing momentum


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Product initiatives ship on a predictable cadence, with scope and tradeoffs understood by everyone involved before work starts

- Customer and stakeholder input is translated into decisions, not just captured

- Exec leadership has an accurate, current picture of the roadmap and can trust the status they hear

- Cross-functional partners in Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and AI/ML see Product as a source of momentum, not a bottleneck


WHO WE ARE

- A true polyglot. You can write a PRD in the morning, jump on a customer call in the afternoon, and review an API spec before end of day

- As comfortable analyzing complex data as you are presenting a strategic roadmap to leadership

- At home in ambiguity. You do not need process handed to you, and you build what is missing rather than waiting for it

- You treat unfinished problems as opportunities rather than blockers

- AI-first in how you work. You reach for AI tooling by default and keep reshaping your workflow and toolset as the work and the tools change

- A deliberate remote collaborator. You over-communicate by default and build trust across departments and time zones without needing a room


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

REQUIRED

- 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or high-growth startup environments

- Proven track record in delivery-heavy roles where you shipped product, not just planned it

- Hands-on experience with AI/ML products, conversational AI, NLP, or messaging platforms

- API and integration fluency, you understand how systems connect and can own the details

- SQL proficiency, you're comfortable pulling your own data rather than waiting on analysts

- An AI-first way of working, you use AI tooling to accelerate your own output without sacrificing quality or judgment, and you actively evolve your workflows and tools as your needs change

- Demonstrated ability to manage external vendor and partner relationships end-to-end

- Strong written communication, your specs and updates are clear the first time

- Proven success leading cross-functional work in a fully remote, distributed organization, building alignment across departments without relying on in-person proximity


STRONG PLUS

- Prior experience in a product-adjacent role, including engineering, implementation, sales, or customer success

- Enough technical fluency to read and reason about code in an AI-assisted development environment, so you can ask sharper questions and pressure-test scope with Engineering

- Interest in prototyping directly to validate an idea or communicate intent faster than a spec can. This is a product role, not an engineering role, you will not be assigned production development work or carry engineering deliverables

- Background spanning both enterprise and startup contexts

- Experience building product for enterprise healthcare, particularly with insurance payers, and familiarity with the compliance and regulatory constraints that come with it


COVER LETTER REQUIREMENT

Please include a cover letter with your application, limited to 250 words or fewer.

In your cover letter, tell us which Drips Core Value you believe you would embody most strongly and why. We're interested in understanding how that value shows up in the way you work, collaborate, and approach challenges.

Our Core Values can be found on the Drips website for you to review before submitting your application.

# Senior Product Manager

Tooploox

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-9176628601521852384?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=628975278809238037&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Product Manager at Tooploox

We're Tooploox, a Solvd Inc. company. We create AI-powered products and services that make a real difference. Our team of nearly 200 specialists - including a 40+ person R&D team with many PhDs - has pioneered AI solutions across industries from healthcare to e-commerce. We've published research in top-tier venues like NeurIPS and ICML, while delivering real-world applications that help our clients innovate and scale.

We are seeking a Product Manager with strong leadership and strategic thinking to join our team and build innovative products and services powered by GenAI and other advanced AI technologies. You'll manage the entire process, from feasibility studies to scaling up, while ensuring smooth stakeholder communication. If you want to have a real impact on how users interact with the technologies of the future, feel invited!

##### What You Will Do

- Identify and prioritize business opportunities and advice clients on possible directions.
- Validate ideas through experimentation to make fast, informed de-risked decisions.
- Set goals and execute them.
- Incorporate data, user research, and market analysis to develop product strategies and roadmaps.
- Lead a cross-functional team of experts in their field, from AI engineers to experienced designers.
- Monitor productization of AI solutions from feasibility study through PoC to release and scale-up.
- Develop trustful relationships with stakeholders and ensure smooth cross-team communication.
- Stay current with the rapidly evolving field of Generative AI.

##### Experience and Skills You Need to Join Us

- At least 5 years of experience in leading cross-functional teams and 5 years in leading digital products in conditions of great uncertainty.
- Sense of ownership and leadership skills with high interpersonal competencies.
- Interest in tech, especially generative AI technology.
- Strong analytical skills and deep product-oriented thinking to make decisions based on qualitative and quantitative data.
- Opportunities and risks identification and proposing solutions taking into account different perspectives.
- Solid background in working in a technical environment with cross-functional and remote teams, preferably international.
- Experience in designing projects' budgets and executing them.
- Practical experience with continuous discovery approach including various validation techniques.
- Excellent communication skills, both English and Polish with the ability to effectively interact with stakeholders from all management levels.

##### It Would Be Great If You Also Have

- Experience in delivering products that leverage AI.

##### We Would Also Need You To

- Be open to business trips.
- Be ok with working with different time zones.
- Accept irregular working hours depending on the product development phase.

At Tooploox, you have the flexibility to choose your working hours and location. While we value remote work, we also believe in building relationships and invite you to join us in our Warsaw and Wrocław offices. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere and try some "home-made" pizza from our office pizza oven. We love having pets in the office, so feel free to bring yours along.

Join us and shape the future of AI while working the way you like!

# Senior Product Manager

$170k - $210k

Chromatic Inc

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-9111261198758208589?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2849763647884548804&crId=US_0US_0)

At Chromatic, our mission is to improve the UX of the internet and safeguard the world's pixels. We're building tools that make it impossible to ship broken UI. Thousands of frontend teams-including BBC, Shopify, and Adobe-use Storybook and Chromatic to map every state of their applications and ensure each one is tested and approved before reaching the billions of people who interact with them daily.

We're seeking a Product Manager to own company objectives for improving our platform. You'll work directly with customers to understand their asks and drill down to the root causes for the problems they're facing. You will also work closely with our design, engineering, and marketing teams to craft product enhancements in support of the metrics backing our objectives. You'll own these features end-to-end from discovery to delivery and work with engineering teams across the platform to do it.

Over the past year, highlights from our team's work include:

- Launched an accessibility regression testing product to help customers continuously improve the accessibility of their front-ends.
- Improved efficiency of agentic workflows with the Storybook MCP hosted by Chromatic as well as other enhancements across the platform.
- Built visual regression testing support for React Native Storybook.

We're at a significant moment in our company's history. We're running a successful business at tremendous scale and your work will immediately impact customers worldwide. We need your expertise to help take us to the next level. Shipping with momentum matters, but we also make space to think ideas through carefully and ship the right things. Our diverse team is full of passionate, curious people who can learn, grow, and feel supported in taking on new challenges. We dive into complex problems and create simple, high-quality, delightful solutions. If you're energized by building developer tooling and being an active user of the product you work on, this is the perfect job for you.

**This is a fully remote position on a cross-functional team for individuals based in the mainland US or Canada.**

**Responsibilities**

- Own the vision for end-to-end business objectives that span multiple engineering teams.
- Synthesize your ideas, our business goals, customer feedback, product analytics and insights gleaned from the marketing/sales teams into feature specifications.
- Work closely with the engineering and marketing teams to ensure we ship world class software that matters to our existing and future customers.
- Manage analytics instrumentation across our products and use it to make data driven product decisions.

**What we're looking for**

- **4+ years** product management experience with SaaS companies.
- **Clear written and verbal communicator** who provides straightforward, self-contained updates with necessary context in our distributed, asynchronous environment.
- **Technical background** strong enough to understand how our tools are used by developers.
- **Strong opinions, weakly held**-someone who pushes back on ideas to drive better outcomes, handles critique without defensiveness, and demonstrates a growth mindset.
- **Evidence-driven mindset**-uses customer feedback and our analytics instrumentation to make informed product decisions.
- **Accountability**-experience leading the end-to-end process for a feature from conception to release.

**We'd be extra excited if you...**

- Were previously a front-end software engineer.
- Have experience working in the developer tooling space.
- Have a keen interest in UI, design and the front-end ecosystem.
- Have worked effectively in a distributed, remote-first team environment.

We understand that even the best candidates might not meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're excited about Chromatic's mission and want to grow your skills, we'd love to hear from you.

**Salary Range:** 170,000 - 210,000 USD + equity. Learn more about our compensation philosophy here. For a list of our other benefits & a peek into life at Chromatic, visit our careers page.

##### Senior Product Manager

North Hospitality - Remote

Join the hospitality experts. Imagine delivering sophisticated hospitality technology, simplified payment processing, and award-winning support to some of the top restaurants in the U.S.

North is seeking a highly detail-oriented and technically proficient Senior Product Manager to drive the execution of our product roadmap and oversee the delivery of innovative, high-impact solutions in the payments and fintech space. You will serve as the technical backbone of the product team, collaborating closely with multiple Agile engineering teams to translate strategic vision into actionable, detailed requirements and deliverables. Daily decisions include prioritization, value, timelines, risk management, and functionality for the Developer Experience Team's product. The Product Manager is able to understand not only the business needs and value, but has an understanding of the technical and system aspects impacted by the projects and business needs.

As the Senior Product Manager, you will dig deep into technical details, coordinate complex cross-functional initiatives, and ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and customer value. You will be responsible for managing and optimizing workflows using Jira and other product management tools, and will play a key role in aligning internal and external stakeholders. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on technical complexity, is relentless about details, can drive order out from multiple competing priorities, and is passionate about building products for developers in FinTech.

What You'll Do:

- Technical Product Ownership: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned product areas, from ideation through delivery and ongoing optimization, with a strong emphasis on technical requirements and system integrations.
- Deep Technical Engagement: Work closely with Agile engineering teams (internal and external) to break down complex business needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
- Agile Leadership: Act as Product Owner for one or more products, providing clear vision, direction, and detailed requirements. Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, and prioritization using Jira.
- Stakeholder Coordination: Gather and synthesize input from internal teams (engineering, product, leadership, sales, and support) and external partners/customers. Ensure alignment and transparency around product decisions, progress, and trade-offs.
- Data-Driven Decision Making: Develop and own processes and tools to collect, analyze, and present data that informs prioritization, risk management, and release planning.
- Release & Roadmap Management: Own and maintain a detailed product roadmap and backlog. Ensure visibility and communication of progress, risks, and changes to all stakeholders.
- Quality & Compliance: Ensure all deliverables meet North's Definition of Ready and Definition of Done. Proactively manage escalations and communicate impact of expedited or unplanned work.
- Continuous Improvement: Collaborate with other Product Managers and leadership to refine and improve product management best practices across North.

What We Need From You:

- Bachelor's (BA or BS) or equivalent experience.
- Four years previous experience as a Product Manager, Product Engineer, Product Analyst, or similar technical product roles.
- Proven experience working with Agile software development teams.
- Strong proficiency with Jira and modern product management software.
- Product Owner Certification (CSPO, etc.) preferred.
- Payments or fintech industry experience highly preferred.
- Exceptional attention to detail and technical depth; able to dive into system architecture, APIs, and data flows.
- Advanced knowledge of Agile methodologies and best practices; experience as a Product Owner on Scrum teams.
- Demonstrated ability to break down complex business and technical problems into actionable requirements and deliverables.
- Skilled in backlog management, roadmap planning, and cross-team coordination.
- Strong analytical skills; able to leverage data to drive prioritization and decision-making.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to convey technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering high-value products.
- Proactive, self-motivated, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
- Innovative thinker who embraces change and continuous improvement.

Travel Requirements: Up to 20%

License and Certification Requirements: CSPO or similar Agile certification preferred

What We Offer:

- Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
- Flexible Paid Time Off
- 401(k) + Match
- Education Assistance
- Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
- Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program
- Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account

Salary Range: $115,000 to $135,000

We are restaurateurs building products for restaurateurs. At North Hospitality, our team has years of experience working in, and for, some of the most renowned hotels and restaurants in the country. Now, we're committed to bringing that passion to restaurateurs everywhere in the form of a single, seamless platform for all operations.

At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

Rezdy
