[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8330639098414377847?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1591980000862599083&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Product Manager — Manifest

Manifest is building modern software for the tours and activities industry.

Our customers run real-world businesses: tours, attractions, experiences, rentals, and activities. They need software that helps them sell more, operate smoothly, and deliver great guest experiences.

We're building a B2B2C SaaS platform that brings booking, ecommerce, payments, accounting, operations, and customer experience together in a modern architecture. The product surface is broad, the workflows are nuanced, and the opportunity is big. That surface now spans several distinct product areas, including a newer, AI-native platform for building and delivering customer websites end-to-end. We're hiring more than one Senior Product Manager, and we'll match each hire to the area where their strengths fit best, from established features to fast-moving, zero-to-one greenfield work.

We're looking for Senior Product Managers to own product direction, roadmap, and prioritization for one or more key areas of Manifest.

This is not a backlog management role. We're looking for someone who can take ambiguous customer and business problems, find the shape of the opportunity, make smart tradeoffs, and help a cross-functional team ship high-quality product experiences.

##### About the Role

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll turn customer insight, business context, and technical possibilities into clear product direction and own the delivery end-to-end.

Modern product work is changing, and this role reflects that. We expect our PMs to be fluent and genuinely enthusiastic users of AI-assisted tools—using Claude, Cursor, v0, and similar tools to explore interactions, build lightweight prototypes, and make product ideas concrete before implementation begins. On some of our teams, AI-native workflows are not just a way of working faster; they're central to the product itself.

You'll work closely with Product leadership, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and design-minded front-end engineers. Depending on the area you own, there may not be a dedicated product designer, so you should be comfortable playing an active role in shaping user workflows, interaction patterns, and overall product quality. You'll also be the bridge between executive vision and execution: taking high-level direction set by our leadership team and honing it into concrete, buildable product requirements. Leadership helps frame the why and the what, but you own the product decisions about what to build and how to bring it to life.

You do not need to be a front-end engineer, and you won't be expected to write production code. But strong technical fluency is a real advantage—enough to collaborate deeply with engineers on UI-heavy, technically nuanced product areas, and to understand the systems you're shaping. A technical or former engineering background is strongly preferred.

You should also be comfortable owning the delivery side of the work, along with the product vision, like milestones, sequencing, and keeping a small team moving.

##### What You'll Do

- Own roadmap, prioritization, delivery, and product outcomes for one or more areas of Manifest
- Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their businesses, and the tours and activities industry
- Lead discovery with customers, internal stakeholders, support teams, sales, customer success, and go-to-market partners
- Translate customer problems, business goals, and operational complexity into clear product direction
- Define product requirements, success metrics, release scope, and tradeoffs
- Partner closely with engineering to shape pragmatic, high-quality solutions, and help sequence and drive delivery
- Work closely with front-end engineers on user flows, interaction details, edge cases, and product polish
- Use AI-assisted tools, lightweight prototypes, wireframes, diagrams, and sketches to clarify product ideas and reduce ambiguity
- Help raise the bar for UX quality, including in areas without a dedicated Product Designer
- Create clear product artifacts: problem statements, opportunity briefs, product specs, workflow diagrams, acceptance criteria, launch plans, and release notes
- Balance customer value, business impact, technical constraints, and delivery realities
- Communicate product direction clearly across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and leadership
- Collaborate with Product leadership on strategy while taking ownership of day-to-day product execution

##### What We're Looking For

- Significant Product Management experience, ideally in a B2B or B2B2C SaaS environment
- A track record of owning roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for meaningful product areas
- Strong product judgment: you can move from ambiguous problems to coherent product direction
- Strong written communication and the ability to create clear, actionable product specs
- A measurement-driven approach to product, defining success metrics up front and proving the impact of changes quantitatively
- Fluency and enthusiasm for AI-assisted product work using tools like Claude, Cursor, v0, Figma, or FigJam to prototype, explore, and communicate ideas
- A technical background, former engineering experience, or strong technical fluency; enough to understand the product deeply and partner closely with engineers on technically nuanced, UI-heavy areas
- Comfort owning delivery and project execution on small teams alongside product vision
- Experience leading discovery, evaluating opportunities, and making thoughtful tradeoffs
- Strong UX instincts and an eye for product quality, usability, workflow design, and polish
- Familiarity with modern front-end patterns, design systems, HTML, CSS, or component-based product development
- Experience with complex workflows, operational tools, booking flows, ecommerce, marketplaces, or other transaction-heavy SaaS products
- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and bring structure to undefined problems, including in zero-to-one / startup-mode environments
- A pragmatic, collaborative operating style

##### Nice to Have

- Experience in travel, tourism, activities, hospitality, reservations, ecommerce, or booking platforms
- Experience working on developer-adjacent products or platforms
- Experience in a scale-up environment where product, design, and engineering responsibilities are highly collaborative
- A track record of using AI tools to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, analysis, or specification in a real production setting
- Experience with analytics, experimentation, funnel optimization, SEO, or conversion-focused product work

##### How We Work

We move quickly, but we care about craft.

Manifest serves users with complex day-to-day workflows, so product quality matters. We care about whether the product makes sense, whether the workflow is intuitive, whether the edge cases are handled thoughtfully, and whether the experience feels modern and trustworthy.

We value product managers who are curious, direct, clear-thinking, and outcome-oriented. We are not looking for someone who simply collects requirements or manages tickets. We're looking for someone who can understand customer problems, shape direction, make tradeoffs, and partner with Engineering from ambiguity through delivery and iteration.

##### Senior Product Manager

As a Senior Product Manager at vCluster Labs, you'll partner directly with the Head of Product and engineering leadership on the decisions that shape where the product goes next. You'd be joining at a pivotal moment as we scale.

**As a Senior Product Manager, your role will include:**

- **Technical Direction:** Align on business priorities and technical direction for your product surface, and translate that into specs engineering can execute against.

- **Founder Partnership:** Work directly with the Head of Product and Engineering leadership on the architecture tradeoffs that determine the product's trajectory.

- **Hands-on Validation:** Run alpha and beta builds yourself. Catch integration issues before customers do.

- **Customer Intelligence:** Engage directly with platform engineers at AI Cloud operators, regulated enterprises, and large internal platform teams. The next zero-to-one comes from these conversations.

- **Market Positioning:** Track the cloud-native ecosystem and emerging tenancy primitives. Sharpen the narrative for technical buyers and partner with GTM on messaging that lands.

- **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Bridge engineering, sales, and marketing so what we ship matches how we sell and support it.


**This Role is a Fit for You if You Bring:**

- **Experience:** 5+ years in product management, in cloud infrastructure, platform services, or distributed systems. You've shipped something other engineers depend on in production.

- **Kubernetes Fluency:** You have working knowledge of Kubernetes, how clusters, workloads, and namespaces fit together.

- **Customer-Facing Infra Experience:** You've sat across from platform engineers and architects, and you're comfortable in that conversation.


**Bonus Points For:**

- **Kubernetes-as-a-Service:** Built a KaaS offering at a cloud provider, vendor, or large internal platform team.

- **AI & MLOps Infrastructure:** GPU scheduling, multi-tenant accelerator workloads, LLM deployment patterns.

- **Internal Developer Platforms:** Platform PM experience building IDPs that abstract infrastructure complexity for developer teams.

- **Startup Growth:** Adaptable to startup pace and change.


##### About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

1. **Make it Happen:** We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

2. **Own the Outcome:** We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

4. **Open Source, Open Mind:** We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

5. **Build Tomorrow's Standards, Intentionally:** We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. # Senior Product Manager - Vendor Relations

Full-time

KPI Solutions

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5435850496359614826?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=354&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5370263702383309499&crId=US_0US_0)

KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience — rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Product Manager – Vendor Relations owns the product strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of material handling and warehouse automation solutions, with primary emphasis on managing and growing the OEM, technology, and equipment vendor relationships that underpin those offerings. Because these solutions only deliver value once vendor hardware and software are working reliably inside the company's and customers' systems, this role also owns the software integration requirements that make multi-vendor solutions function as one system — defining API contracts, data exchange standards, and technical acceptance criteria alongside the commercial relationship. This role serves as the strategic and technical bridge between engineering, IT, sales, operations, and external partners — including robotics and automation OEMs, WMS/WES/WCS providers, and equipment/parts suppliers — ensuring product commitments align with vendor capabilities, integration feasibility, contract terms, and long-term partnership health. The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with deep comfort negotiating, managing, and growing multi-vendor ecosystems, and enough technical fluency in software integration (APIs, data interfaces, middleware) to evaluate vendor claims and de-risk integration in a complex, integration-heavy industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Vendor Relations & Partnership Management (Primary Focus)**

- Serve as the primary product-side point of contact for OEM and technology vendors (e.g., robotics, AS/RS, conveyance, WMS/WES/WCS, controls) throughout the partnership lifecycle.
- Lead vendor evaluation, onboarding, and tiering processes; negotiate commercial terms, SLAs, and roadmap commitments alongside Procurement and Legal.
- Own the vendor scorecard process — tracking reliability, cost, lead time, quality, and roadmap alignment — and drive corrective action plans with underperforming partners.
- Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key suppliers and technology partners to secure preferential pricing, priority allocation, and early access to new capabilities.
- Coordinate joint go-to-market activities, co-development initiatives, and technology roadmap alignment sessions with strategic vendors.
- Manage vendor contract renewals, escalations, and dispute resolution in partnership with Legal and Finance, protecting margin and delivery commitments.
- Represent the company at vendor summits, industry trade shows (MODEX, ProMat, MHI events), and partner advisory boards.

**Software & Systems Integration (Vendor Interoperability**)

- Own the technical requirements and acceptance criteria for integrating vendor-supplied software and hardware (robotics controllers, WMS/WES/WCS, PLC/controls) with internal platforms and customer environments, partnering closely with Engineering and IT.
- Define and document API contracts, data exchange formats (e.g., REST/SOAP, EDI, MQTT), and middleware requirements needed for vendor systems to interoperate reliably with company and customer software stacks.
- Lead technical due diligence during vendor evaluation and onboarding — assessing integration complexity, data ownership, security posture, and architectural compatibility — before commercial terms are finalized.
- Oversee integration testing, user acceptance testing, and go-live certification with vendors ahead of customer deployments — work executed by the Technical Product Owner — ensuring interface and data-mapping issues are identified and resolved accurately prior to launch.
- Ensure the vendor integration playbook (API specifications, data mapping, versioning and upgrade paths) — maintained day-to-day by the Technical Product Owner — is accurate, current, and effectively reduces integration risk and rework across projects.
- Review the Technical Product Owner's assessment of whether vendor capabilities can be consumed through standard interfaces versus requiring custom integration work, validating accuracy before effort and cost estimates feed into build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions.

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

- Define and maintain the product roadmap for assigned material handling / automation solution lines, balancing customer needs, vendor capabilities, and competitive positioning.
- Translate vendor technology capabilities and constraints into product requirements, specifications, and release plans.
- Conduct market and competitive analysis across MHE, robotics, and warehouse software segments to inform build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions.
- Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with Engineering and Solutions Design, accounting for vendor lead times and integration complexity.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

- Partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering to support proposals, RFP responses, and client presentations that depend on vendor-supplied technology.
- Work with Implementation and Field Service teams to resolve vendor-related product issues impacting live customer deployments.
- Partner with IT and Engineering to define integration architecture standards and reusable connectors across the vendor ecosystem, reducing one-off integration work on future projects.
- Provide vendor and product roadmap input to Finance for cost modeling, pricing, and margin analysis.
- Train internal sales, service, and support teams on new vendor technologies, product updates, and positioning.

**Requirements**

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
- 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on vendor/partner or supplier relationship management.
- Demonstrated experience in the material handling, warehouse automation, robotics, or broader supply chain/logistics industry.
- Proven track record negotiating vendor contracts, SLAs, and commercial terms.
- Working knowledge of WMS, WES, WCS, and/or PLC/controls ecosystems, and hands-on familiarity with how they integrate with material handling equipment via APIs, data interfaces, and middleware.
- Demonstrated experience defining or evaluating software integration requirements (APIs, data exchange, middleware) between third-party/vendor systems and internal or customer platforms.
- Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.
- Comfortable managing multiple concurrent vendor relationships and competing priorities in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
- Preferred
- MBA or advanced degree in a related field.
- Product management certification (e.g., Pragmatic Institute, AIPMM).
- Direct experience partnering with automation OEMs such as AutoStore, Geek+, Hai Robotics, or similar technology providers.
- Experience at a systems integrator, equipment OEM, or software provider serving the MHI space.
- Familiarity with contract/vendor management tooling and CRM/PLM systems.
- Experience with integration platforms (iPaaS), API testing/documentation tools (e.g., Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI), or a systems integration certification.

**Competencies**

- Vendor & Partnership Management — builds durable, mutually beneficial relationships and negotiates from a position of long-term value, not just short-term cost.
- Strategic Thinking — connects vendor ecosystem decisions to broader product and business strategy.
- Technical Acumen — understands material handling equipment, automation, and software integration (APIs, data interfaces, middleware) well enough to evaluate vendor claims and integration risk critically.
- Influence & Communication — articulates trade-offs clearly to engineers, executives, and external partners alike.
- Commercial Judgment — balances cost, quality, and delivery risk when structuring vendor agreements.
- Collaboration — works effectively across Product, Engineering, Sales, Procurement, and Legal.

**Benefits**

**What we Offer:**

- Medical Insurance
- Dental Insurance
- Vision Insurance
- Health Care Concierge Service
- 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax & Roth)
- Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability & Long-Term Disability
- Voluntary Life & AD&D Insurance
- Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity Insurance
- Pet Insurance
- Milk Stork Program
- Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges
- Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & 10 Holidays)
- Training & Development

Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus performance-based bonus tied to product and vendor-partnership outcomes. Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, paid time off, and professional development support.

**Why KPI Solutions?**

At KPI Solutions, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting role—it’s an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance.

##### IV.AI Product Manager

IV.AI was founded in 2016 with a focused mission: to help humans become smarter while tackling hard problems that require artificial intelligence. We pair natural language processing (NLP) models with quantitative and generative AI to solve high-stakes business problems for our clients. As a distributed and collaborative global team, we are committed to driving real, measurable value for our customers through innovative technology and exceptional service.

You'll own one of IV.AI's core data product lines end to end, spanning consumer panel data and web intelligence capture, for blue-chip clients. Your job is turning raw data acquisition into reliable, client-ready insight products. You don't just write requirements and hand them off; you read the data yourself, dig into anomalies, and act as a credible technical counterpart to engineering on schema and pipeline decisions.

Product line ownership

- Own the roadmap and day-to-day product decisions for your data product line end to end, from data acquisition/capture through data quality to the client-facing insights blue-chip clients depend on.
- Be involved in the full product lifecycle, from problem definition through shipped, measured outcomes.

Data quality and technical depth

- Treat data correctness as the top priority. Define what "good data" means for your product, partner directly with engineering on schema, pipeline design, and validation logic, and own the metrics that prove it's working.

Growth and metrics

- Drive growth within your product line. For panel-based products, this includes contributor/panelist acquisition, activation, and retention. For web intelligence, this includes source coverage and data freshness.
- Instrument and monitor the metrics that matter for your product (funnel visibility, capture coverage, data delivery reliability) and use them to prioritize the roadmap.

Client-facing product and cross-functional alignment

- Translate raw data capability into client-facing insight products. Write the specs, define the dashboards, and make the call on what ships.
- Represent your product line in cross-functional planning, aligning with the other data product PM and engineering on shared data contracts and standards across product lines.
- Run your roadmap, specs, sprints, and day-to-day execution through tools like Linear and Notion, keeping planning and documentation visible to the team.
- Use AI tools as a core part of your own workflow, for research, drafting specs, data analysis, or prototyping, and look for real opportunities to build AI/NLP capability directly into the product itself.

The reality of this role

- Small, distributed team: you'll help build the roadmap and standards, you don't inherit them fully formed.
- You'll work directly with engineers, not just hand off requirements.

What we're looking for

- Bachelor's degree
- 4-6+ years of experience, including meaningful time in a Product Manager role (or an equivalent hybrid technical/product role) within a small team environment.
- Strong technical and data fluency. Comfortable reading SQL, understanding how data pipelines and schemas work, and speaking engineer-to-engineer about data contracts, quality, and architecture.
- Experience owning a product or feature area end to end, from data/requirements through to shipped, measurable outcomes.
- A track record of using data and metrics (funnel, quality, usage) to drive prioritization decisions, not just track them.
- Excellent written communication. Comfortable producing clear specs, dashboards, and updates for both technical and client-facing audiences.
- Fluency with modern PM tooling (Linear, Notion, or equivalents) and with using AI tools (e.g., Claude or similar) as a regular part of your own workflow.

Helpful, not required

- Experience with consumer panels, market research, or behavioral/passive data capture products.
- Web scraping and social listening experience, as well as purchasing third party data when appropriate.
- Familiarity with BigQuery, PostgreSQL, or similar warehouse/analytics tooling.
- Experience working with or managing enterprise/blue-chip clients.
- History building high performing mobile app products.
- Experience shipping AI/NLP-powered features, not just using AI tools day to day.

# Senior Product Manager

$170k - $190k

Tango

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6172449967299779755?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2292443063518287236&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Product Manager

As Senior Product Manager at Tango, you'll be our one and only PM—the product counterpart to a senior design team that's been waiting for you. Our product org is led by three senior product designers with 35 years of combined experience who have been carrying product strategy alongside their craft. They're exceptional at it, and they're ready for a true product partner so both disciplines can operate at a world-class level. You'll own the roadmap for a platform spanning documentation, in-app guidance, and automation. You'll report directly to our CEO and work closely with our co-founders, design, and engineering. Your first big swing: leading our MCP and agent-platform work, bringing AI to our customers in ways that are actually useful, not just shiny.

This is a rare shape of role: you steer where we're going, hold the bar on what ships, own rollout planning, and measure whether it worked, with a design team that can take a strong PRD and carry it to the finish line. Senior IC scope, with real ownership. You'll be in the weeds where it counts: customer conversations, data, PRDs, launch plans. And you'll be setting the standards that define how product is done here.

This is a remote position based in the US, with periodic off-sites to meet your teammates in person.

##### What You'll Do

- Steer the ship. Own the roadmap: decide where we invest, back every call with customer evidence and data, and keep the through-line clear across everything in flight.

- Find the next opportunity. Look beyond today's product for Tango's next big swing, and earn conviction the hard way: customer conversations, evidence, and small tests before big bets.

- Live with our customers. Run a continuous discovery cadence, own the voice of the customer internally, and turn what users ask for into what they actually need. You'll be the person in the company who knows our customers best.

- Hold the bar and measure the impact. Define what "up to par" means for what we ship, drive post-launch analysis, and be the honest voice on whether we accomplished what we set out to do.

- Own rollout planning. Take launches from PRD through go-to-market: sequencing, packaging, enablement, and the post-launch loop.

- Lead our AI and MCP platform work. Define how Tango plugs into the agentic ecosystem and ship AI features that solve real workflows, not demos.

- Partner with a world-class design team. Write strong PRDs and watch three senior designers carry them further than you thought possible. They love discovery and product thinking, so you'll do your best work with them, not around them, while owning prioritization, rollout, and commercial rigor.


##### What You'll Bring

- 7+ years in software product roles, with a track record of helping scale products people genuinely love

- Experience at two or more companies or products; we believe seeing the movie twice leads to a richer perspective

- A deep customer-discovery habit: you've built your best work on top of real user conversations, and you can prove it

- Systematic and data-driven: fluent in product analytics, comfortable designing experiments, able to self-serve the data you need

- Relentless follow-through: you carry the through-line across multiple projects and close every loop

- Exceptional written and verbal communication: you lead with clear, structured direction and can align executives, engineers, and customers around one narrative

- Comfort being the senior product voice in the room, with the judgment to make calls under ambiguity and the humility to change course when the data says so

- Bonus: you've shipped AI-powered products or built with MCP; you're the kind of person who's genuinely obsessed with the frontier of generative AI, not just keeping up with it; experience mentoring or coaching others; B2B SaaS serving both self-serve users and enterprise buyers; growth/monetization work (pricing, packaging, trials)


##### About You

- You're practical and allergic to BS. You'd rather ship the right small thing than present the impressive big thing.

- You're seriously curious about customers, about how things work, and about why that one metric moved.

- You take AI seriously—as a practitioner, not a cheerleader. Believer or skeptic, you've used the tools enough to have earned opinions about what's genuinely useful and what's hype.

- You're low-ego and high-motivation. You care more about the product being great than about being right.

- You want to build a product function, not just join one. Defining the standards, rituals, and ways of working is your idea of a good time.

- You're fun. We're a down-to-earth group of goofballs who work hard, and we're serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. You should raise our bar for rigor and fit right in at the off-site.


##### Compensation

Our base salary compensation is $170,000 – $190,000 for this role, and the total compensation package will also include equity and benefits. We value each employee based on their impact within the company, regardless of their location. Due to this, we set salary ranges for all roles based on function, level, and benchmark against similar-stage growth companies. We share salary ranges on all job postings to comply with local legislation and provide greater transparency to candidates. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including past candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. Additionally, we offer annual compensation reviews and have an annual equity refresh program.

##### AI Mindset

At Tango, we operate with an AI-first mindset. We expect all team members across every function to actively engage with AI and incorporate it into their work. This includes using AI tools to improve productivity, streamline collaboration, and deliver stronger outcomes for our customers. We're looking for people who are already building, learning, and finding ways AI can enhance their impact. You don't need to have all the answers, but you should be in the habit of trying.

##### Why Join Tango?

We believe teams that support and challenge each other are destined to win. That's why we provide a competitive suite of benefits to support your personal and professional growth journey—and have some fun along the way.

##### Tango Benefits

- Full Medical/Dental/Vision coverage with 100% employer contribution, FSA, and an HSA for qualified plans

- Competitive compensation + meaningful equity

- Work from anywhere in the US, with UberEats and Deskpass stipends—on us!

- Generous annual stipend for Learning & Development & Productivity

- Health and Wellness stipend

- Unlimited PTO, 10 holidays, 4 personal volunteer days, 4 mental health days, and birthdays off

- Paid parental leave

- Subsidized National Parks Annual Pass

- Subsidized Roller Skates (yes, seriously)

**Leave It Better** – Be an owner, not a renter. Cultivate a growth mindset.

##### Senior Product Manager, Payments

Remote

##### The Role

We're hiring a senior, hands-on Product Manager to join WooCommerce Payments and take ownership of a defined area within our payments products and partner integrations.

You'll collaborate closely with the Head of Product, and work day-to-day with engineering, design, support, and partnerships. This role is deeply executional. You'll spend much of your time in the work: in Linear writing and refining issues, triaging bugs and incidents, reviewing and shaping flows in Figma, creating lightweight prototypes, and writing briefs or PRDs when they're needed.

Payments at WooCommerce run at a serious scale—billions in total payment volume—and the quality of this experience directly affects merchant revenue, shopper conversion, and the success of Woo's commercial engine. This role sits right where reliability, trust, and execution matter most.

##### What You'll Work On

- Own product direction and execution for a key part of the payments product area, with clear goals, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
- Improve merchant and shopper experiences across onboarding, checkout, refunds and disputes, payouts, reporting, and overall reliability.
- Raise the quality bar by reducing failures and friction, lowering support volume, and improving product ratings and merchant trust.
- Use data, support signals, and merchant feedback to decide what to work on next, define success measures, and make tradeoffs explicit.
- Work closely with priority payments partners (including Stripe and PayPal) to improve integrations, ship changes, manage dependencies, and resolve issues.
- Keep stakeholders aligned through clear, direct writing and communication about progress, risks, and decisions.

##### What We're Looking For

- 7+ years in product roles, with senior IC experience owning complex problem spaces and influencing cross-functional teams through clarity of communication and precision of execution.
- 4+ years in payments or fintech, ideally on products operating at scale; experience with large or global launches is a plus.
- Strong product judgment. You can make good calls in messy situations and don't need perfect information to move forward.
- Comfort working on critical, high-trust systems where reliability matters and small changes can have outsized impact.
- Ability to work deeply with engineers and designers on complex problems, including technical constraints and tradeoffs.
- Strong analytical habits and a practical approach to metrics, dashboards, and instrumentation.
- Clear written and verbal communication in a distributed, async environment.
- Familiarity with WooCommerce, WordPress, or open-source ecosystems is a plus.

Salary range: $170,000-$240,000 USD. Please note that salary ranges are global, regardless of location, and we pay in local currency.

We are searching for high-caliber candidates with the skills and qualities to have a net positive for Automattic. Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, go beyond the range stated.

We're pleased to offer a straightforward, competitive base salary, providing financial clarity without complex variable components. This isn't your typical work-from-home job: we are a fully-remote company with an open vacation policy. To see a full list of benefits by country, consult our Benefits Page.

##### About Automattic

Now in our 20th year, we're the people behind WordPress.com, WooCommerce, Beeper, Tumblr, Simplenote, Jetpack, Longreads, Day One, PocketCasts, and more. We believe in making the web a better place.

We're a distributed company with more than 1500 Automatticians in nearly every corner of the globe, speaking over a hundred different languages. Enriched by this diversity, we're united by a singular mission: to democratize publishing, commerce, and messaging so anyone with a story can tell it, anyone with a product can sell it, and everyone can manage their communications from a single source. In short, we help maintain a balance in society, creating and continually refining powerful tools people can use to compete fairly—regardless of income, gender, politics, language, or where they live in the world.

# Senior Product Manager

Blaze

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/572633443447257994?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=654510673171456130&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Product Manager

We're building the world's first agentic marketing platform around a simple belief: the world doesn't need more AI slop. It needs more human taste, judgment, and creativity. Blaze is built to amplify those qualities, using AI to help small teams create extraordinary marketing that drives real growth at a fraction of the cost of working with an agency. With Blaze, customers can spin up new channels quickly, create high-quality marketing content, and publish across ads, video, social, blog, and email from one place, with results that compound over time. Blaze has served tens of thousands of small business owners and growing teams. Now, we're scaling the platform and our team as we work toward serving millions of customers. That's where you come in.

At Blaze, product managers aren't backlog organizers or consensus collectors. They're people with taste who bring strong, well-formed opinions about what great looks like, grounded in real customer insight, and fight for quality even when it's inconvenient. You'll work alongside engineering, design, and marketing to set a bold roadmap and ship products that feel deliberate, cohesive, and high-quality. You'll also play a role in uncovering new opportunities, taking them from 0 to 1, and staying accountable for the outcomes.

This ideal PM for Blaze is a curious technologist: someone who actively explores new AI products, thinks about where the space is headed, and can translate emerging capabilities into concrete customer value. You don't just follow trends—you play with them, form opinions, and imagine what's next. This is a hard role. It requires judgment, conviction, and care. But if you love our mission, obsess over customers, and believe great products are felt—not just shipped—you'll feel at home here.

Specifically, you will:

- Work with our leadership team set product direction and priorities, with clear accountability for the quality and consistency of what Blaze ships to customers.
- Own the product development lifecycle end to end—deciding what gets built, what gets fixed, and what gets cut—while holding a high bar for the outputs that reach production.
- Partner closely with engineering and design leadership to guide technical and design execution, make tradeoffs, and ensure every release meets expectations for reliability, usability, and output quality.
- Collaborate with our customer and marketing teams to identify the highest-impact product opportunities, using customer feedback and product data to continuously raise the quality and usefulness of Blaze's output.

At Blaze, how we work is as important as what we build. We're on a mission to create something ambitious, and our culture is central to that aim. We move fast, own our work, and get things done. This is a high-ownership, high-growth environment where feedback fuels progress. If you're ambitious, proactive, and driven to build something meaningful, you'll thrive here.

We love to hire people who:

- Care deeply about their work. You can't help but to be all in, and you're ready to swing big to make things happen, no matter what it takes!
- Are amazingly competent. You move fast, crush complexity, master the unknown, and power through anything.
- Are hyper structured thinkers and communicators. You're often right, crave feedback, and write like a pro → clear, data-driven, and to the point.
- Move faster than anyone they know. You set bold timelines, crush them, and move faster than anyone - never letting process slow you down.
- Have professional maturity. You stay calm, assume good intent, and keep work fun - while building strong, easy relationships.

Experiences that make you stand out:

- Product training and experience at a top tier technology company
- At least one tour of duty in a high-growth startup environment (Series B/C preferred)
- Hands-on experience shipping AI-native features in production - bonus points for image/video generations or agent-based workflows
- Building for SMB/prosumer segments where output quality directly impacts metrics
- Success stories that prove your ability to drive improvements in conversion, retention, monetization, or expansion metrics

Skills that make you extraordinary:

- AI Systems Architect: you think in prompt and model pipelines, know how to set up eval structures, and can design for impact v. cost/latency constraints.
- Elite Taste & Output Judgment: you can articulate what makes content feel agency-grade and brand-worthy, and can backwards engineer how to produce it with AI.
- Retention & NRR Instinct: you evaluate product decisions based on conversion, retention, and expansion, and feels responsible for revenue impact, not just shipping.
- Radical Simplicity Discipline: you're ruthless about scope, and can distill complex AI capability into intuitive, minimal user experiences, knowing what to keep v. cut.
- Founder-Level Ownership: you operates like a CEO of your metrics or feature areas, making decisions decisively, navigating ambiguity calmly, and protecting team velocity.

Our Commitment to You:

We're building a space where you can do exceptional work for decades. We commit to fostering a culture where work feels joyful, rewarding, and sustainable—a place where people are valued not just for what they do, but for who they are.

What you'll get from us:

- Collective support—and mentorship from your manager—in achieving major wins
- Encouragement to take risks, try new things, and be creative with your work
- Opportunities to exchange and engage in feedback
- Continual chances to stretch yourself and raise your own bar
- Rewards for achieving excellence and mastery
- The satisfaction of building a game-changing AI marketing solution to help small businesses save time, drive sales, and grow with their marketing on autopilot.

Interviewing at Blaze:

It's our goal to provide an efficient, transparent interview experience that respects you and your time. Our roles typically have a four stage process (sometimes more) and we like to move through those as quickly as calendars allow. After submitting your application you will hear from us whether you are a strong fit for the role or not! From here you can expect:

- An initial screen with our Lead Recruiter
- An interview with our COO
- A take-home exercise demonstrating your skills as a PM
- A leadership interview with our CEO
- Peer panel with our product, design, and engineering leads

# Senior Product Manager

Q4

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6512021962352934141?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6835188784177149104&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Senior Product Manager

The Senior Product Manager role is responsible for developing and executing product strategies and roadmaps aligned with business goals and market trends. The role drives the product development process through collaboration with cross-functional teams and utilisation of market research to inform product decisions. This role will have a strong external focus, engaging with customers, global stakeholders and industry sources to refine and prioritise the strategic direction of the solution.

##### Product Strategy and Planning

- Develop and execute product strategies and roadmaps aligned with overall business goals and market trends
- Define and prioritise product requirements, user stories, and use cases based on customer needs and business objectives
- Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to inform product decisions
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather input and ensure smooth product development and launch
- Identify market opportunities, emerging trends, and customer pain points to drive product innovation
- Define and communicate the product vision, roadmap, and strategy to internal and external stakeholders
- Discover and validate market problems (both for existing and future customers)

##### Product Development

- Drive the product development process from concept to launch, including defining product specifications, collaborating with engineering teams, and overseeing testing and quality assurance
- Build, and own, the product roadmap of incremental improvements and iterative development
- Collaborate with marketing and sales teams to develop product collateral, sales enablement tools, and marketing campaigns to drive product adoption and revenue growth
- Provide input into go-to-market strategies, product positioning, and messaging for product launches
- Data analysis of customer feedback and user testing to inform product decisions and iterate on product features and functionality
- Define and track product performance metrics, conduct data analysis, and generate insights to measure product success and identify areas for improvement
- Research and evaluate new technologies, industry trends, and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for product differentiation and competitive advantage

##### Cross-Functional Collaboration, Communication and Mentorship

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success, to ensure alignment and smooth execution of product initiatives
- Build relationships, and maintain open lines of communication within the company and with key external stakeholders
- Create and distribute regular updates of changes and progress within the solution roadmap
- Foster a collaborative and inclusive culture within the product team and across the organisation
- Foster a positive and collaborative learning environment by providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members and contributing to their professional growth and development

##### Support Build Processes

- Write the user stories that reflect the key outputs, from a customer perspective, to ensure the engineering team have sufficient context and requirements and a clear "definition of done"
- Contribute to the engineering planning process by providing insights of product strategy and vision to relevant parties
- Participate in relevant scrum ceremonies (such as sprint planning and sprint reviews as a key stakeholder)
- Determine buy/build/partner decisions
- Conduct high-level technology assessments to determine suitability for use in the product
- Monitor delivery progress and communication to stakeholders regarding delays and launch timeframes to make sure they're informed and dependencies can be managed

##### Product Performance and Profitability Analysis

- Develop profitability calculation data relating to the potential or actual success of a proposition using ROI, cost of delay or other modelling tools to determine products/features to add, keep, retire or grow
- Define and analyse product success metrics to evaluate the success of the product and changes/new features launched
- Perform data analysis in collaboration with the BI team to extract product usage statistics
- Gather and organise market data research to develop and articulate the positioning and value of a proposition in various possible markets
- Work with key customers, analysts and members of the global organisation to gather requirements for future releases based on feedback

##### Key Qualifications

- Deep experience of product development processes, methodologies, and best practices covering the product lifecycle
- Excellent communication skills across all mediums
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, sales, support and customer success to achieve successful product outcomes
- Experience in conducting market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to inform product decisions
- Data-driven mindset, with experience analyzing verification performance metrics, running experiments, and leveraging insights to drive product improvements
- Proven track record of successfully developing and launching software products, preferably in a global or fast-paced startup environment
- Strong understanding of product development processes, methodologies, and best practices
- Demonstrated experience in driving product strategy, roadmap planning, and product lifecycle management
- Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, such as engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success, to deliver successful product outcomes
- Experience in conducting market research, competitive analysis, and customer insights to inform product decisions

##### Bonus

- Certifications or specialised training in product management or related fields
- Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies, and exposure to product management tools such as Jira, Asana, or Trello
- Experience in the SaaS industry, with a deep understanding of SaaS business models
- Track record of successfully working with global remote teams
- Experience in product management for enterprise-level or B2B SaaS products
- Experience with Agile or Scrum methodologies, and familiarity with product management tools such as Jira, Asana, or Trello
- Experience with go-to-market strategies and product positioning
- Experience with decision engines and billing systems

If you meet most, but not all, of the qualifications listed above, we still encourage you to apply. We recognize that strong candidates come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we value the diversity of perspectives that brings.

##### Our Culture

Certn is a remote-first company with a high-performance edge. We value hustle, hunger, and helping each other win - but we also have a strict no-jerk policy. Ambition here is about lifting people up, not stepping on toes.

- We think like owners and execute with urgency.
- We're customer-obsessed and always learning.
- We give real feedback and hold each other to high standards.

##### AI in Our Culture

We're AI enthusiasts. From Ops to Legal, Product to People & Culture, we use AI to move faster, make smarter decisions, and build better experiences.

We believe in using AI intentionally - ethically, creatively, and always in service of delivering more for our customers and each other. Don't worry if you're not an expert; curiosity and a willingness to learn matter most.

##### What's in it for you?

- 32 days of paid time off per year
- Company-paid benefits that start on day 1
- Remote-friendly and supportive flexible remote arrangements
- Work-from-home allowance
- Professional development budget
- And a few more goodies!

##### Come As You Are

We're committed to building a workplace that's diverse, inclusive, and empowering for all. If you need accommodations to support any special needs at any stage of the recruitment process, just let us know - we've got you.

##### One Last Thing…

Just so you know, the selected candidate will be required to complete a background check. This means you will get to see first hand what we do, and trust us, we do it REALLY well!

##### How We Hire

We use AI tools to support our recruitment process, including helping us organize applications and identify early matches based on role criteria. That said, every rejection decision is made by a human. We encourage candidates to apply authentically and avoid relying solely on AI-

##### Job Title

Circle's Market & Ecosystem Intelligence Capability Builder

##### Job Description

Circle is one of the world's leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle's platform includes the world's largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation.

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

##### Responsibilities

You will help build and run Circle's Market & Ecosystem Intelligence capability by turning complex, fragmented market signals across stablecoins, payments networks, and regulation into clear, decision-grade insights that guide strategy, capital allocation, product prioritization, regulatory positioning, and executive decision-making.

##### Tasks

- Track global stablecoin market structure, including market share shifts, distribution dynamics, and competitive positioning

- Monitor on-chain liquidity flows and exchange concentration to surface fragmentation, venue dependency, and displacement risk

- Analyze reserve disclosures and key dependencies across counterparties, custodians, and distribution channels

- Build and maintain competitor dossiers, including network expansion moves and go-to-market strategy signals

- Monitor adoption of stablecoins by card networks, PSPs, banks, and cross-border/real-time settlement platforms

- Track digital asset regulatory and policy developments (US, EU, APAC) and maintain a jurisdictional risk tracker

- Deliver executive-ready intelligence outputs (impact summaries, escalation memos, and scorecards) tied to defined early-warning triggers


##### Qualifications

Core Requirements

- 3–5 years of experience in strategy, competitive intelligence, financial research, fintech, payments, digital assets, or consulting

- Strong analytical and structured-thinking skills, with the ability to translate ambiguity into clear, defensible insights

- Ability to synthesize regulatory, technical, and financial inputs into concise, executive-ready narratives

- Strong writing skills, including experience producing decision memos and leadership-facing materials

- Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with limited structure and evolving priorities

- Ability to prioritize independently, manage multiple workstreams, and deliver reliably against deadlines


Preferred Requirements

- Experience with blockchain analytics tools such as Dune, Nansen, or Glassnode

- Familiarity with stablecoin market structure, liquidity dynamics, and ecosystem drivers

- Exposure to regulatory policy analysis across major jurisdictions

- Experience supporting senior executives and/or Board-level materials

- Background in payments, banking, or treasury analytics This role is based in our Bangalore office and requires employees to work from the office on a regular basis.


Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

##### Senior Technical Product Manager

Are you ready to shape innovative products in the fast-growing AdTech industry? We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager who can combine strong product thinking with technical expertise to drive impactful digital advertising solutions.

At Sigma Software, you will join a team of 300+ AdTech professionals delivering scalable platforms and data-driven products for international Customers ranging from global enterprises to ambitious startups. This is a remote-friendly opportunity for a proactive product leader who enjoys working at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and innovation.

We as a company value ownership, collaboration, and continuous growth. You will have the opportunity to influence product direction from the earliest stages, work with modern technologies, and contribute to products used by businesses worldwide.

The project focuses on building and evolving scalable advertising technology platforms used for campaign management, targeting optimization, data processing, and integrations with major advertising ecosystems. The environment combines product strategy, technical leadership, and close collaboration with engineering and business stakeholders to deliver market-ready solutions.

The team works with cloud-based architectures, Big Data processing pipelines, Machine Learning-driven optimization approaches, and API integrations with leading ad exchanges and advertising platforms. In this role, you will help shape product vision, drive discovery activities, and align business goals with engineering execution.

##### Job Description

- Develop and execute the product roadmap, ensuring focus on the most impactful initiatives aligned with business goals
- Gather and consolidate requirements from multiple business stakeholders, identifying common goals and opportunities
- Translate business needs into a clear product vision, strategy, and roadmap initiatives
- Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and priorities for engineering teams
- Collaborate closely with engineering, architecture, design, client success, and business stakeholders to ensure successful product development and feature delivery
- Drive product discovery activities, proposing new ideas and improvements based on business needs, customer feedback, and market opportunities
- Communicate product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities across cross-functional teams, architects, and technical leads
- Coordinate cross-functional initiatives and ensure effective collaboration between business and engineering teams
- Define and track product KPIs and metrics to measure success and identify areas for improvement
- Present product plans, progress, and results to executives, Customers, and partners
- Gather and evaluate customer feedback and insights to improve product capabilities and ensure products meet customer needs
- Monitor AdTech industry trends and emerging technologies
- Contribute to strategic product decisions and long-term product direction

##### Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or Product Lead
- Strong technical background with the ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams and Customers
- Experience working with complex technology products or platforms
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to independently drive product initiatives
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
- Experience gathering and prioritizing product requirements from multiple stakeholders
- Experience defining roadmaps, user stories, and product documentation
- Strong ownership mindset and proactive approach to decision-making
- Ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
- Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
- Strong organizational and prioritization skills
- Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn
- Upper-Intermediate or higher English level

Experience in AdTech domain will be a plus.

$155k - $175k

Concert Health

##### Senior Technical Product Manager

USA - Remote

##### Who We Are

Concert Health is the leading national behavioral health medical group committed to integrating the Collaborative Care model into existing health care practices to improve patients' lives. We believe everyone, regardless of location or insurance, should have easy access to personalized, high-quality behavioral health support that is guided by the provider they trust.

Our Collaborative Care program effectively targets and treats most behavioral health conditions, while embracing behavioral health as central to the patient's care journey and overall health. With its clinical excellence and operational efficiency, Concert Health is the preferred partner for health systems and medical groups seeking to deliver integrated behavioral health care that is both scalable and sustainable.

##### About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to drive the execution of our vision: a unified technology experience for our clinicians and patients that brings together EHR/EMR implementations, our care management platform, patient engagement tools, and healthcare data analytics. You'll join a small, dynamic product and technology team, shaping and delivering against an ambitious roadmap. As a technical product manager, you'll have the opportunity to bring together your product manager and product owner skills - partnering with clinical stakeholders to understand requirements, prioritizing the roadmap, mocking up features, writing user stories and documentation, iterating with great software engineers, collaborating with user support teams, and working with analytics - to deliver high impact features. This is not a typical project or program manager role, but a product-focused leader who translates product led growth strategy into scalable solutions and measurable impact.

##### What You'll Do

- Lead the prioritization, and execution of customer EHR/EMR integrations and implementation capabilities, partnering closely with customers, implementation, engineering, clinical operations, and third-party vendors to deliver seamless interoperability, accelerate customer onboarding, and ensure successful deployment and adoption.
- Become an expert. Get to know our exceptional clinicians - find ways to delight and remove administrative burden, to improve collaboration with primary care partners, and to engage patients in their care.
- Own and drive the product roadmap for patient and provider engagement applications, for integration and analytics, and for APIs and integrations with new data systems.
- Define requirements. Work with our solutions, clinical and other teams to understand and refine requirements.
- Create user stories and acceptance criteria. Convert requirements into user stories (independent, negotiable, valuable, estimable, small, testable), collaborating with architects to define a logical, iterative path for each feature.
- Iterate with development teams to turn user stories into product features - guiding and prioritizing the daily, iterative work, and validating successful completion of each step.
- Drive knowledge transfer to our solutions team related to features you own, ensuring successful transition from development to documentation, training, adoption, and support.
- Use and grow your technical skills. We're a dynamic startup and a small team, so you'll have the opportunity to take on other projects, including design, complex testing, deep root cause analysis, and the creation of BI and reporting assets for internal teams and our customers.

##### Who You Are:

- 5+ years' agile and advanced product management experience.
- Practical competency with all skills and responsibilities of a "full stack product manager."
- Deep knowledge of EHR/EMR workflows with healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR, HL7, integration strategies and tools, preferably with Salesforce platform.
- Ability to function with a high level of autonomy, driving multiple projects in parallel, and to provide multiple option proposals with risk/benefit analyses.
- Ability to make trade-off decisions between possible and desirable, finding leverage opportunities, which requires a good sense of what is technically feasible.
- Demonstrated use of data and forecasting to build business cases, analyze performance and drive decision-making.
- Passion for enabling great patient care with technology and demonstrated success building enterprise healthcare solutions - navigating HIPAA, data privacy, payer and other constraints to create simple, elegant user experiences.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
- A positive, proactive mindset, combined with excellent prioritization and task management skills.
- Ability to storyboard, and create basic mockups and wireframes.
- Analytical, methodical approach to problem solving – exceptional ability to break concepts and requirements into detailed, independent, estimable and testable user stories and logical iterative steps for development.
- Ability to provide clear direction, set measurable goals, manage details, and track delivery
- Strong competency with Azure DevOps or equivalent SDLC platform, and the application of INVEST or similar structured approaches to user story-writing.

##### Bonus Points For:

- Knowledge of behavioral healthcare domain - clinical workflows, care delivery, revenue cycle, etc.
- Some form of highly technical experience (e.g. as a software developer, BI/data developer, etc.).
- Demonstrated expertise with reporting and analytics tools (QuickSight, Tableau, XLS modeling).
- Experience as a Salesforce.com end user.

##### Benefits:

- 100% remote with employer supplied computer equipment
- $50.00/month non-taxable remote stipend
- Work/life balance with 10 paid holidays, sick time, and flexible PTO plans
- Medical, Dental, and Vision plans effective on the first day of employment
- First Stop Health to medically enrolled members and their immediate family members for FREE
- Employer paid Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability plans
- Employer paid Life and AD&D insurance of $50,000
- Employer paid Parental Leave of 12 weeks
- 401K

Salary Range: $155,000 - $175,000

##### Senior Technical Product Manager, Payer Products

Mongoose builds the software that health plans, TPAs, and their clients rely on to administer benefits. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our payer-facing product portfolio end to end — from strategy and roadmap through delivery and client rollout. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable writing a crisp PRD, sitting in a client implementation call untangling a real-world edge case, and understand why something behaves the way it does. You'll set direction for payer products while staying close enough to implementations to make sure what we ship actually lands for the clients using it.

Own the payer product roadmap. Define the vision, strategy, and prioritization for one or more payer products, balancing client needs, market trends, and technical feasibility.

Write clear, complete PRDs. Translate ambiguous problems into well-scoped requirements that engineering, design, and QA can execute against with minimal back-and-forth.

Partner on client implementations. Work directly with implementation and client-services teams during rollouts — surfacing product gaps, unblocking configuration and integration issues, and feeding real deployment learnings back into the roadmap.

Lead cross-functionally. Drive alignment across engineering, design, client services, sales, and compliance without formal authority. Keep everyone rowing in the same direction.

Direct the product design work. Collaborate closely with UX designers to shape flows and interfaces; give clear problem framing and sharp feedback so the design solves the right thing.

Manage and grow analysts. Directly manage product/business analysts — setting priorities, coaching, and turning their analysis into decisions.

Stay technical. Engage with engineers at the level of architecture and trade-offs. Review technical designs, understand system constraints, and make informed calls on scope and sequencing.

5+ years in product management, including ownership of complex B2B or enterprise products; time at senior/lead level preferred.

Payer domain expertise — hands-on familiarity with health insurance / payer operations: claims, benefits administration, member and eligibility data, accumulators, coverage, or related areas. You understand how payers actually work.

Engineering background — you were an engineer by trade (or have equivalent hands-on technical depth). You can reason about systems, and hold your own in an architecture discussion.

Demonstrated experience writing PRDs and shipping products through a full lifecycle.

Experience working alongside implementation or professional-services teams on client deployments.

Track record of leading cross-functional teams and partnering effectively with UX/design.

People-management experience, or clear readiness to manage analysts.

Strong communication skills — able to move fluidly between an executive summary and a technical deep-dive.

##### Sr. Technical Product Manager

Integrated Resources, Inc is a premier staffing firm recognized as one of the tri-states most well-respected professional specialty firms. IRI has built its reputation on excellent service and integrity since its inception in 1996. Our mission centers on delivering only the best quality talent, the first time and every time. We provide quality resources in four specialty areas: Information Technology (IT), Clinical Research, Rehabilitation Therapy and Nursing.

##### Job Description

Position is responsible in assisting with the product management, planning, development, delivery, and life-cycle management of new video products & features, platform enhancements, and advanced technologies for FiOS IPTV.

Candidate must be a strong leader in product development with systems analysis skills and the ability to take business requirements and create technical requirements and user stories/journeys.

This position will interface directly with internal development teams and with key external stakeholders and product owners.

Responsibilities include performing various support activities for key product management deliverables, including product requirements documentation, product line performance metrics and cross-functional team coordination.

Additionally, this candidate will be responsible for:

- Identify market trends, perform competitive analysis, and assess impact/opportunities for new video initiatives.
- Deliver business and product requirements documents, feature prioritization, use-cases and write user stories.
- Work hands-on with development, QA, designers, business, marketing and operations teams to successfully design, build, and deploy product features.
- Develop Software/Network requirements and functional specifications. Provide solutions leadership throughout the development process.
- Assist in the development of product & platform positioning, feature development roadmap, and service requirements.
- Prepare presentations on project initiatives for mid and upper-level management on a regular basis.
- Working with various aspects of product management for a MVPD video service, with focus on DVR functionality, Merchandising, Service Assurance, and OSS integration.
- The successful candidate should also expect to work very closely with Release Engineering and solidify the release cadence and build process for Content Management System delivery. This is especially important as the post GA roadmap is finalized. The business unit and commercial product team will need to understand (with a degree of predictability) what the release train looks like for v1.1, v1.2 features.

Required Qualifications:

- 2+ years of experience in Technical Product Management
- Experience with consumer video products & technologies or Content Management Systems
- New product development experience in a fast paced, agile development environment
- Previous exposure or experience with business case process and development
- Strong analytical and problem solving skills and experience
- Experience with large project teams in matrix organization is desirable. Requires ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, external business partners, and software vendors in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong organization skills
- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Strong leadership skills
- Degree in business or technology field required; MS preferred, experience in Software Development required
- Previous experience with requirements and bug tracking tools like JIRA and Confluence is a benefit, although not required.
- Must be able to travel for business in the United States (less than 25%).
- Working understanding of software development process
- Solid track record of delivering quality products and or systems.

Injective Labs Inc.

##### **About Injective Labs**

Injective Labs is trailblazing a new dawn for Web3 enabled finance. We are the core contributors to Injective, one of the fastest growing blockchains in the industry.

Injective provides an interoperable smart contracts platform that is optimized for building decentralized finance applications. Interoperability is at the core of Injective, which is natively integrated with chains such as Ethereum, Cosmos and Solana. Developers can rapidly launch premier financial applications suited for mass adoption using Injective’s infrastructure and specialized DeFi primitives such as the world’s first fully on-chain order book.

Our team has decades of experience spearheading the largest financial institutions and tech organizations. Injective is incubated by Binance and is backed by leading firms such as Jump Crypto, Pantera and Mark Cuban.

##### **About the role**

_Full-time Position – Hybrid or Remote – Ideally NY._

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to help shape and scale products across the Injective ecosystem. You will work closely with engineering, design, and leadership teams across multiple initiatives, helping drive product direction, prioritization, and execution from ideation through launch and iteration.

We’re open to different backgrounds for this role. You may come from a strong crypto-native background with deep understanding of exchanges, DeFi, or financial systems, or from a leading technology company with experience building and scaling high-quality technical products. What matters most is strong product thinking, execution, communication, and genuine curiosity about the future of crypto and finance.

##### **Who is this role for?**

This role is for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has strong product fundamentals, likes working with high ownership, and can operate effectively in highly technical environments. Most importantly, this role is for someone genuinely passionate about DeFi. Someone who can quickly understand context, challenge the status quo, and constantly push the bar to deliver better products and user experiences.

If you consider yourself someone who knows how to take ownership, lead initiatives end-to-end, and at the same time roll up your sleeves and operate as an IC, this role is for you.

If you’re looking for highly structured processes, clearly defined playbooks, or a comfort-zone environment, this role is probably not for you. We move fast, priorities evolve quickly, and we value people who are proactive, adaptable, and drive solutions forward.

##### **Responsibilities:**

- Drive product development across multiple initiatives, from new products and feature ideation through launch, iteration, growth, and continuous improvement
- Contribute to product strategy and roadmap planning aligned with company objectives
- Partner closely with engineering, design, and leadership teams to define product direction and priorities
- Own prioritization decisions using user feedback, product intuition, data, and business context
- Translate complex technical concepts and user needs into clear product requirements and execution plans
- Maintain a strong product quality bar across user experience, functionality, and execution
- Define and monitor key product metrics and use insights to improve decision-making
- Work cross-functionally with teams across engineering, growth, BD, operations, and support
- Operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and high ownership expectations

##### **Who you are:**

- 7+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably working on technical or infrastructure-heavy products
- Strong product fundamentals and proven product judgment
- Strong technical understanding and experience working closely with highly technical teams, with a solid understanding of finance
- High ownership mentality with the ability to independently drive initiatives forward
- Comfortable operating in ambiguity and fast-moving startup environments
- Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
- User-focused with strong attention to product quality and execution standards
- Technical background, engineering experience, or a technical degree is a strong plus
- Genuine interest in crypto, financial infrastructure, and emerging technologies
- Experience in crypto, exchanges, DeFi, fintech, trading systems, or financial products is a strong plus
- Experience at high-performing technology companies is also highly valued
- Fluent in English
- Ideally based in New York or open to relocating

##### **Why work with us?**

- Competitive salary and INJ token award
- Unlimited PTO
- Equipment
- Home Office Stipend
- Opportunity to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology in the finance industry.
- Collaborative team culture with opportunities for professional growth and development.
- Global team meet ups.
