# Lead Product Manager- Agentic Tax

C T Corporation System (DE)

[Coppell, TX](https://jooble.org/jobs/Coppell%2C-TX)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-4300382265324235878?p=1&pos=0&rgn=45972&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4992030244545992975&crId=US_0US_0)

Basic Function

Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting seeks a strategic, customer-focused Lead Product Manager to lead product definition, portfolio strategy, and business outcomes across a product portfolio, platform, or major customer domain. This role serves as a senior Product Definer and business leader responsible for identifying market opportunities, defining investment priorities, shaping product strategy, and delivering measurable customer and commercial outcomes. The Lead Product Manager drives alignment across Product, Engineering, UX, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership to ensure product investments create sustainable competitive advantage, revenue growth, customer value, and market leadership. The ideal candidate combines deep product management expertise, strong commercial acumen, customer-centric thinking, and advanced understanding of AI-enabled product innovation to guide both strategy and execution at scale.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy & Product Leadership

Define and communicate product vision, portfolio strategy, investment priorities, and outcome-based roadmaps across multiple products, capabilities, customer journeys, or platform domains.

Synthesize customer needs, market dynamics, product performance, competitive intelligence, regulatory trends, and business objectives into strategic growth opportunities.

Lead where-to-play and how-to-win decisions, including customer segments, market opportunities, platform investments, and emerging technologies.

Establish portfolio OKRs, business cases, success metrics, and measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

Drive prioritization decisions balancing customer value, business impact, scalability, technical complexity, risk, and long-term strategic objectives.

Partner with executive leadership to evaluate growth opportunities, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and platform investments.

Ensure product strategies support revenue growth, customer retention, market expansion, profitability, and enterprise objectives.

Serve as a thought leader on industry trends, customer workflows, competitive positioning, and product innovation.

Commercial Ownership & Growth Leadership

Own business outcomes across assigned portfolio areas, including adoption, retention, expansion, revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

Lead pricing, packaging, monetization, and value realization strategies in partnership with Product Marketing and business leadership.

Define market-entry, launch, adoption, and expansion strategies for new products, capabilities, and customer segments.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success leadership to accelerate customer acquisition, retention, and growth.

Establish mechanisms to gather and translate customer, partner, and market feedback into commercialization and investment decisions.

Lead strategic customer engagements, customer advisory boards, and executive-level discovery efforts.

Identify adjacent markets, ecosystem partnerships, distribution opportunities, and new growth vectors.

Customer Discovery, Design & Innovation

Establish discovery frameworks and research practices that scale customer understanding across teams.

Lead complex customer discovery initiatives involving enterprise customers, strategic accounts, partners, and key market segments.

Drive customer journey analysis, workflow mapping, unmet-needs identification, and opportunity assessment.

Sponsor experimentation programs that validate assumptions and inform investment decisions.

Guide development and validation of concepts, prototypes, MVPs, and strategic product initiatives.

Ensure customer insights are translated into product strategy, roadmap decisions, and measurable business outcomes.

Champion customer-centric product development practices across the organization.

AI & Agentic Product Leadership

Define and execute AI and agentic product strategies that create differentiated customer value and competitive advantage.

Establish frameworks for evaluating, prioritizing, testing, and scaling AI-enabled product opportunities.

Drive adoption of AI-powered workflows across product management, customer research, experimentation, and product delivery processes.

Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Architecture, and UX teams to design intelligent experiences and workflow automation solutions.

Establish responsible AI governance, risk management practices, transparency standards, and human-in-the-loop controls.

Evaluate emerging AI technologies, market trends, and partnership opportunities to accelerate innovation.

Serve as a strategic advisor on AI-enabled product transformation initiatives.

Data-Driven Portfolio Management

Define portfolio-level measurement frameworks across customer, operational, product, and commercial performance dimensions.

Leverage product usage data, customer insights, financial performance, market signals, and operational metrics to guide investment decisions.

The Role
Medely’s vision to transform healthcare staffing is only realized if professionals (supply side) can seamlessly connect with facilities (demand side) through our on‑demand marketplace. As the Lead Product Manager for Marketplace org, you will help answer business‑critical questions: how do we ensure and improve on an industry‑leading fill rate, how can we create the best match between a Pro and assignment, what should be the key elements of our pricing strategy, how should we think about dynamic pricing, what levers do we use to maintain a balanced marketplace, how should we think about trade‑offs across all dimensions including reliability vs convenience vs quality. You will operate as a key thought leader and decision‑maker across both business and tech. You will work with a broad set of cross‑functional partners across sales, operations, engineering, data science, design, and more!

Our ideal candidate for this role will be someone who thrives in a fast‑paced environment, is motivated by challenging problems and constraints, and is passionate about great user experiences, scaling through technology, and combining quantitative and qualitative data to guide decision‑making.

The Impact You'll Make

Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lead delivery of products that impact healthcare professionals, and facilities in our labor marketplace.

Own and lead the end‑to‑end product development process of major features and iterations, including creating high‑quality PRDs, and working closely with engineering, design, and operations to bring world‑class products to market.

Be actively involved in defining the strategy for your program. Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues that may impair our ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals.

Innovate – find new ways of simplifying the user experience with new technologies.

Monitor and measure launched products and feed insights back into the product development process.

Own your numbers, drive your cross‑functional team of engineers and data scientists to set qualitative objectives and quantitative goals – challenging all members to think ambitiously and creatively – and overachieve them.

Distill vision and strategy for the team, and rally all cross‑functional team members. Clearly communicate product plans, benefits, and results to stakeholders.

Who You Are

7+ years of product management experience shipping software at scale in start‑ups or large‑scale tech companies.

Prior experience building and launching data‑driven products using machine learning. Ability to effectively engage ML engineers and data scientists to set a long‑term technical/product vision and deliver on it.

Proven track record of working collaboratively with technical and non‑technical team members up to and including the executive level. Marketplace org requires coordination with multiple stakeholders including operations, sales, and support.

Superior verbal and written communication skills. Comfortable presenting product roadmap and status to the business leadership regularly.

##### Product Owner

If you're a data-driven strategist who gets energized by building new and impactful customer-facing experiences, you might be the perfect fit!

You'll join the team behind a new consumer-facing small commercial quoting and binding experience already driving meaningful growth at Liberty Mutual. This is early-stage, high-upside work, and as a Product Owner, you'll own a value-add backlog across two scrum teams, partnering cross-functionally to develop journey maps, define objectives and key results (OKRs) and gather feedback to inform what you build next.

This is a highly visible role with a direct line to growing our small commercial book of business. You'll balance qualitative insights and quantitative data to guide decisions, shape product vision, drive incremental delivery, and create portfolio runway through strong cross-functional partnership.

If you're curious, tenacious and excited by the chance to shape a new digital sales experience from its earliest chapters, this is a role you'll want to explore.

Key responsibilities

- Define and communicate product vision and strategy aligned with portfolio and organizational priorities.
- Own and prioritize the product backlog; write clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria that enable engineering to deliver business value.
- Lead stakeholder engagement across business, technology, and executive leadership to set expectations for timelines, capabilities, and trade-offs.
- Translate customer problems and business objectives into actionable work, focusing both squads on the highest-value outcomes.

Ideal candidate will have

- Background in small commercial insurance, an important foundation as the experience is scaled.
- Strong strategy and visioning: You dream big and act boldly, listening to customers, incorporating business objectives and articulating a clear strategy for where a new platform goes next.
- An experimental mindset: You're comfortable making calls on incomplete information, and you'd rather learn fast from a small test than debate your way to certainty.
- Curiosity and tenacity: You deeply understand opportunities and rally cross-functional teams to execute.
- Analytical foundation: Data informs and supports your work, and you recognize that a data-driven mindset is imperative to identifying and solving problems at scale.
- Comfort in ambiguity: You are a self-starter and a leader, impacting outcomes through collaboration.
- Stakeholder management: You are a strong storyteller with the ability to influence both executive and technical audiences.
- Reside in the Eastern Standard Time zone.

This position requires two in-office days per week for candidates who reside within 50 miles of Columbus, OH; Seattle, WA; Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Indianapolis, IN; or Plano, TX.

##### Qualifications

- Advanced knowledge of Agile development methodologies as typically acquired through a Bachelors' degree in relevant field (business, computer science, humanities etc.), 7 years in business, technology, or consulting with 5 to 7 years direct experience with agile teams
- Master's degree preferred
- High level of proven business expertise needed to set clear priorities for product and understand business value impacts
- Develops strong stakeholder relationships and influencing across multiple organizational boundaries
- Demonstrated experience leading varied audiences through the development of complex ideas, issues and designs
- Ability to lead varied audiences through census building
- Proven experience with Agile practices and expectations
- Comfortable with making decisions with some level of uncertainty
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- Knowledge of insurance industry preferred
- Knowledge of relevant products and portfolio strongly preferred
- Strong experimental mindset to drive innovation amongst uncertainty and exploit market opportunities

## **Become a part of our caring community** Become a part of our caring community Join a world-class marketing organization creating the best possible engagement experience for millions of members. Humana is a $100+ billion, Fortune 50 healthcare leader dedicated to improving the health and well-being of some of the most vulnerable populations in the United States, including seniors, people with disabilities, and lower-income Americans. Humana is uniquely positioned to transform healthcare delivery by making high-quality care more affordable, accessible, and secure through integrated healthcare services, innovative technology, and data-driven solutions. To help deliver on this mission, we are seeking a Product Owner to support the continued expansion of Humana's enterprise Next Best Action (NBA) decisioning capability. As part of the NBA product organization, this role will serve as the bridge between product strategy and implementation by translating approved actions, treatments, and business requirements into complete, standardized, implementation-ready documentation. Working closely with NBA Product Managers and configuration teams, the Product Owner will ensure requirements are clearly defined, internally consistent, and sufficiently detailed to support successful implementation within the NBA platform. This role will help establish and maintain the standards, documentation, and operational practices that support scalable action configuration as the NBA platform continues to expand across new use cases, channels, and business areas. Role Responsibilities - Serve as the primary point of coordination between NBA Product Managers and teams responsible for implementing action and treatment configurations. - Translate approved business requirements into standardized, implementation-ready documentation that supports efficient configuration and deployment. - Ensure actions and treatments are fully defined, documented, and aligned with established NBA standards before implementation begins. - Manage documentation associated with action metadata, eligibility criteria, channel availability, treatments, content references, business rules, and related configuration requirements. - Review requirements for completeness, consistency, and implementation readiness and identify gaps, conflicts, or ambiguities requiring resolution. - Partner with Product Managers to obtain missing information, clarify intent, and resolve outstanding requirement questions. - Maintain accurate documentation as actions, treatments, business rules, channels, and content requirements evolve over time. - Support backlog management activities for configuration work, aligning priorities with direction provided by NBA Product Management. - Track implementation progress and help ensure open requirement questions are resolved in a timely manner. - Provide clarification and guidance to implementation teams regarding documented requirements and expected behavior. - Support change management activities by updating requirements and documentation as approved modifications are introduced. - Maintain visibility into actions and treatments moving through definition, configuration, testing, and implementation. - Identify recurring documentation challenges and recommend improvements to templates, standards, and requirement-management practices. - Support ongoing evolution of the NBA Action Catalog and related implementation standards. - Contribute to the development of scalable documentation and configuration practices that enable broader adoption of NBA capabilities across the enterprise.

## **Use your skills to make an impact**

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- Demonstrated experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Product Management, Requirements Management, Platform Administration, or a related role.

- Experience translating business or product requirements into structured, implementation-ready documentation.

- Experience reviewing requirements for completeness, consistency, accuracy, and usability by downstream implementation teams.

- Demonstrated ability to identify requirement gaps, resolve ambiguities, and collaborate with stakeholders to clarify business intent.

- Experience documenting business rules, workflows, configuration requirements, or other structured implementation specifications.

- Experience managing or supporting a backlog of implementation, configuration, or product-related work.

- Strong written communication and documentation skills.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, changes, and implementation activities concurrently.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy across large volumes of structured information.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders, Product Managers, technology teams, and implementation resources.

- Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with Pega Customer Decision Hub, Pega Decision Management, or comparable decisioning technologies.

- Familiarity with concepts such as actions, treatments, eligibility criteria, business rules, prioritization, and channel management.

- Experience maintaining structured product documentation, configuration specifications, metadata repositories, catalogs, or comparable assets.

- Experience working in healthcare, health insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry.

$110k - $130k

Full-time

## Company Description Privia Health™ is a technology-driven, national physician enablement company that collaborates with medical groups, health plans, and health systems to optimize physician practices, improve patient experiences, and reward doctors for delivering high-value care in both in-person and virtual settings. The Privia Platform is led by top industry talent and exceptional physician leadership, and consists of scalable operations and end-to-end, cloud-based technology that reduces unnecessary healthcare costs, achieves better outcomes, and improves the health of patients and the well-being of providers.

## Job Description

The Senior Product Owner will focus on business automations and AI applications, serving as a high-impact, strategic product leader responsible for end-to-end product execution, roadmap definition, and business outcome delivery. This role combines rigorous day-to-day tactical product ownership (sprint planning, backlog health, high-velocity engineering partnership) with strategic, data-driven vision. Operating with high autonomy, consistency, and a relentless sense of urgency, the Senior Product Owner leverages data and product analytics to build roadmaps, align senior executive stakeholders, and establish product best practices. This position is designed for an exceptional, senior-level operator with the readiness and ambition to rapidly step into a Manager of Product Management capacity.

- Product strategy and roadmap:

• Build and maintain multi-quarter product roadmaps tied directly to business goals and operational needs.

• Turn operational problems into clear requirements, scoped milestones, and prioritized backlogs.

• Research market trends and competitor tools to identify practical product opportunities.

• Communicate product plans, trade-offs, and progress clearly to leadership and operational teams.

AI development and delivery:

• Lead the launch of AI and automation features that solve real workflow and operational problems.

• Propose practical build vs. buy decisions with engineering, comparing model accuracy, latency, and vendor costs.

• Set up testing and evaluation to catch hallucinations, verify data quality, and keep models reliable.

• Enforce data privacy and security rules.

Budget and ROI management:

• Assist in managing product budgets with strict cost discipline

• Write clear business cases for new features showing expected payback, operational savings, or revenue impact.

• Calculate and track unit economics, identifying exactly what each transaction or workflow costs to run.

• Measure realized ROI after launch and cut or change features that do not meet cost and return targets.

Execution and delivery:

• Run projects independently, clearing roadblocks and managing cross-team dependencies.

• Write clear functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build against.

• Help define, track and maintain SLAs, system uptime, and performance metrics across your product line.

• Spend time with stakeholders to understand pain points and turn feedback into practical fixes.


## Qualifications

- 5+ years of full-lifecycle product management experience delivering B2B SaaS or healthcare software products.
- • 2+ years of product experience defining, launching, and managing AI or machine learning features.
- • Proven track record of hitting the ground running in high-pace environments..
- • Experience managing product budgets, tracking cloud or API costs, and proving positive ROI on delivered features.
- • Strong technical foundation to discuss API design, architecture trade-offs, and token costs directly with engineers.
- • Solid background in agile delivery, sprint planning, and backlog management in Jira.
- • Ability to dig into complex technical problems and make decisions independently.
- • Must comply with all HIPAA rules, regulations, and patient privacy requirements.

_The salary range for this role is $110,000.00 to $130,000.00 in base pay and exclusive of any bonuses or benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance, 401K, paid time off, and other wellness programs). This role is also eligible for an annual bonus targeted at 15% a nd restricted stock units . The base pay offered will be determined based on relevant factors such as experience, education, and geographic location._

Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It’s a big mission, and even though we've made a lot of headway, we still have work to do — and that’s where you come in!Our Product Managers (PMs) have ownership over product optimizations and features, from independently run experiments to major product decisions. Backed by strong analytical skills and business acumen, and inspired by access to senior leadership and transparency into how they make product decisions, our PMs develop insights that lead to new product ideas and Duolingo’s next beloved feature. Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.About the role...Duolingo is the world's most popular learning app. Beyond our core learning product, we also offer English proficiency testing with the Duolingo English Test, and are bringing new subjects into the Duolingo app, where people can develop their Math, Music, and Chess skills.As the Senior Product Manager for the Duolingo English Test, you'll drive product changes across the entire user experience: acquisition funnel, monetization, security, and test development. In addition to your product responsibilities, you'll partner with 90 cross-functional colleagues across engineering, AI research, design, marketing and more.Together, you’ll make sure that students can gain access to educational opportunities by taking an English test from the comfort of their home. With over 6,000 partner institutions, we are disrupting the high-stakes language-assessment market. About KoddiWe are a global technology company with software and services that help top digital marketplaces effectively monetize their first-party audiences through industry-leading commerce media technology and strategy. Our enterprise platforms leverage first-party data to drive marketplace revenue and profit by improving user experience and target shoppers throughout the purchase path. Koddi’s platforms enable any advertiser, any marketplace, in any industry to increase awareness, generate demand, and drive revenue. We are committed to driving innovation and growth in the commerce media space.As part of that commitment, we’ve launched Koddi Academy, a learning platform designed to provide expert knowledge, competitive insights, and practical strategies for thriving in this fast-growing industry. Explore our latest certification course, to deepen your expertise and stay ahead in the evolving world of commerce media.You can also sign up for our waiting list to be notified when new courses are released. # Senior Product Manager

Pebl

[Palo Alto, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Palo-Alto%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7209725171594385442?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7558&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6962481227080036232&crId=US_0US_0)

Purpose in Every PositionPebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI-powered Global Work Platform, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere.Where Your Work Moves the Needle.At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a role—you’re accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work.What Makes You a Great FitWe are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Integrations & Partner Embed at Pebl. HR platforms, HRIS providers, PEOs, and payroll tools all serve the same buyers we do—and they want to offer EOR capabilities to their customers without building their own infrastructure. You will define how Pebl’s EOR platform is embedded inside partner products, and build the integration layer that connects Pebl seamlessly to the tools our clients already use.This is a hybrid position based in Palo Alto, California, and in-office collaboration is required for at least 3 days per week. You will be an individual contributor.How You’ll Make An ImpactOwn the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Pebl's partner embed program — defining how EOR capabilities are surfaced inside third-party HR platforms under co-branded or white-label experiencesDefine and ship the native integration layer that connects Pebl with HRIS, payroll, and HR tech platforms — including the data model, sync architecture, and error-handling experiencePartner with the Partnerships team to evaluate and prioritize embed and integration opportunities, setting the criteria for which partners to pursue and in what orderWork closely with engineering on API design, webhook architecture, and developer experience — writing clear specs that external partner teams can build againstDefine the end-to-end experience for embedded flows, from initiating an EOR hire inside a partner platform to tracking a new employee through onboarding, without leaving the partner UITranslate partner requirements and client pain points into prioritized, clearly scoped product requirements — with explicit trade-offs documentedDefine and track success metrics for each integration and embed partnership, running experiments and iterating based on adoption and operational dataCommunicate roadmap, trade-offs, and progress clearly to stakeholders and leadershipLet’s Connect If You Have5+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 2 years owning an integration, platform, or partner product areaDeep familiarity with API design, webhooks, and data sync patterns — you can spec an integration end-to-end and spot edge cases before engineering doesExperience with B2B2B or embedded product models — you understand the commercial dynamics and the product complexity of building for a partner's customer, not your ownTrack record owning a product area end-to-end — from strategy to shipped, adopted featuresHands-on approach to data — comfortable analyzing usage patterns, and instrumenting features to measure impactStrong written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to execs (internal & external) and engineers alikeStartup experience, either in FinTech or HR tech preferablyExperience taking a product from 0-1 preferablyOur Commitment to YouAt Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include:Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge.Parental Leave – Support for growing families.Health and Dental Insurance – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones.Retirement Savings + Employee Incentive Plan – Plan for the future while sharing our success.Please visit our career page for more information.Pebl is an Equal Opportunity Employer.We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world.Compensation Range: $182K - $220KLocation Palo Alto, CA Employment TypeFull timeLocation TypeHybridDepartmentProduct & DesignCompensationStarting Base Salary Range $182K – $220K • Offers EquityOur job titles may span more than one career level. Overview

# Lead Product Manager

FanDuel

[Atlanta, GA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Atlanta%2C-GA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1820339854821756504?p=1&pos=0&rgn=10460&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4346152107645826935&crId=US_0US_0)

THE POSITIONOur roster has an opening with your name on itFanDuel is hiring a Lead Product Manager to drive the strategy and execution of Account Management and Profile experiences across our portfolio of products — from Sportsbook and Casino to Racing, Daily Fantasy Sports, and new product categories on the horizon. From account creation and personal details management to profile customization and account settings, you'll shape how millions of customers manage their accounts and personal information across FanDuel every day, working at the intersection of customer experience, regulatory complexity, and multi-product ecosystem management.You'll partner closely with Engineering, Product across other verticals, Risk/Fraud, Finance, Compliance, and Legal to build account management experiences that are customer-first, compliant, resilient, and built to scale. This is a high-impact role for an experienced product leader who wants to own meaningfulIn addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.THE GAME PLANEveryone on our team has a part to playProduct Strategy and Vision: Partner with the Director of Product to define and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for Account Management and Profile — balancing customer experience, operational efficiency, and regulatory/compliance requirements.Account Management Experience: Own the end-to-end account management journey across FanDuel's portfolio — personal details, profile customization, account settings, and self-serve capabilities — designing experiences that balance ease-of-use with the controls, disclosures, and auditability required for a regulated environment.Cross-Product Collaboration & Account Hub Evolution: Enable seamless account experiences across all FanDuel products (Sportsbook, Casino, Racing, Predicts, DFS). Identify and drive self-service opportunities that reduce friction, increase customer autonomy, and improve the overall account management journey across the multi-product ecosystem.Industry and Product Expertise: Build deep knowledge of account management product features, user journeys, and customer identity/profile best practices. Stay informed on market shifts, competitors, and emerging personalization technologies to refine the product roadmap.Performance, Optimization & Metrics: Drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, completion rates, and account feature adoption while maintaining strong controls. Establish, track, and communicate the success metrics (HEART scores, task success, conversion, user happiness) that matter and use a data-driven approach to prioritize work and demonstrate impact.Compliance & Self-Serve Expansion: Partner with Compliance, Legal, and Risk to evolve account self-service capabilities that increase customer autonomy while meeting regulatory requirements (e.g., customer verification, account settings management, T&C acceptance flows).Experimentation and Iteration: Champion a test-and-learn approach: concept validation, A/B tests, pilots, and phased rollouts to validate account experience improvements before broad launches.Product Quality and Delivery: Partner with engineering to ensure clear requirements, strong acceptance criteria, and high-quality launches. Manage dependencies, triage issues, and act as an escalation point to keep delivery on track across multiple product pods.Cross-functional Leadership: Lead complex initiatives end-to-end—from discovery and business case through delivery and iteration. Align stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk/Fraud, and Operations; remove blockers and drive decisions.Stakeholder Management and Influence: Deliver concise, action-oriented communication and confidently present to senior leadership and cross-functional partners to secure buy-in, align priorities, and drive outcomes.THE STATSWhat we're looking for in our next teammate7+ years of product management experience with a track record of driving measurable business outcomes through customer-facing experiences.Experience with account management, identity, profile/personalization, or customer data products is preferred. We'll also strongly consider candidates with experience in adjacent domains — customer onboarding, conversion optimization, self-serve platforms, or marketplace account features.Demonstrated ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable business impact — e.g., user engagement, feature adoption, conversion, retention, revenue generation, cost optimization, or comparable KPI improvements.Experience leading and developing others as a direct manager — at least one product manager or analyst reporting to you, with evidence of their growth under your leadership.Comfort working in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments, with experience partnering closely with Legal, Compliance, and Risk (or equivalent functions).Technical fluency: comfortable collaborating deeply with engineering on APIs, complex identity systems, multi-product architecture, and third-party vendor integrations.Strong business acumen: crafting business cases, prioritizing tradeoffs, and communicating clearly with executive stakeholders.Excellent written and verbal communication; able to influence without authority across senior leadership and cross-functional partners.Passion for sports, sports betting, or sports-adjacent products; existing knowledge in these areas is a plus.Bonus: exposure to AI in a product context — whether that's using AI tools to accelerate your own product workflows, leveraging AI to build product features, or simply a strong curiosity and aptitude for incorporating AI into how modern PMs work.Don't check all the boxes? That's okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel you possess adjacent skills and are interested in learning more.ABOUT FANDUELFanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America’s #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry’s unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV+, its leading direct-to-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico.The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).PLAYER BENEFITSWe treat our team rightWe offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO & sick leave), annual bonus and long-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more - check out all our benefits here: FanDuel Total Rewards. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level.FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, “We are One Team!”. As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included.FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short-term or long-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. # Senior Product Manager

Taskrabbit

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6635230568101510634?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-8182940301301383331&crId=US_0US_0)

About Taskrabbit:Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!This role operates on a hybrid schedule requiring two days of in-office collaboration per week in our San Francisco office (130 Sutter Street). About the Role:As Senior Product Manager for Commerce, you will own Taskrabbit's global commerce platform, which covers how clients pay for their tasks and how Taskers get paid for their work. The Commerce team's goals are to make it easy for clients around the world to book and pay, get Taskers their earnings quickly and reliably, reduce what we spend to process payments, and keep our payments platform compliant and reliable in every market we operate in. As the PM for the team, you will propose, shape, and execute the initiatives that move us toward these goals. You'll lead a team made up mainly of backend engineers and partner with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Support, Risk, and Legal to identify problems, prioritize the work that matters most, and deliver it.We're looking for someone who knows the payments landscape well and can lead independently from day one. You don't need marketplace experience. What matters more is that you care about the people on both sides of a payment, you dig into problems until you understand why they happened, and you're comfortable going deep into how payments systems work behind the scenes.What You'll Work On:Own the global commerce platform, including client payments (e.g., payment methods, booking experience) and Tasker money movement (e.g., payouts and earnings) across every market we operate in.Improve how payments work for our users, e.g., launching new payment methods that increase booking conversion in different markets, reducing payout delays for Taskers, and removing friction from checkout.Investigate payment issues end to end. When something goes wrong (a spike in declines, a delayed payout, numbers that don't match what Finance sees), you'll find the root cause using every tool available, including AI tools to explore data and system behavior.Plan and sequence the team's initiatives with your engineering lead and drive them to delivery, balancing user-facing improvements, cost reduction, compliance requirements, and platform health.Prioritize ruthlessly. There will always be more work than the team can take on, so you'll decide what moves the needle and be clear about what we won't do.Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Tax, Support, Risk, and Legal, and communicate the roadmap and outcomes to Taskrabbit senior leadership.Your Areas of Expertise:Payments experience: You have deep experience building B2C payments products (e.g., integrating with payment processors, adding payment methods like PayPal, BNPL, or SEPA, managing payouts), and you know the landscape well enough to lead with minimal supervision from day one. Global payments experience is a strong plus.Product sense for payments: You understand how the payment experience shapes user behavior and business outcomes, and you can tell which improvements will actually move conversion, retention, or cost. You track metrics like authorization and decline rates, and you know where to look when they move.User champion: You care about the problems users run into with payments, and you don't stop at the first answer. You keep asking why until you get to the root cause. # Group Product Manager

$130k - $185k

BLC BACKLOTCARS Inc

[Lake Carmel, NY](https://jooble.org/jobs/Lake-Carmel%2C-NY)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/3448160855567254149?p=1&pos=0&rgn=33459&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6776014866225064136&crId=US_0US_0)

Who We Are: At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful. We’re a technology company building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles. We’re a data company helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use. And we’re an innovation company accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.
Our Values: Driven Waybuilders. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate. Relentless Curiosity. We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience. Smart Risk-Taking. We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition. Fearless Ownership. We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.
We’re Looking For: We are seeking a Group Product Manager with experience in product strategy development, agile methodologies, and team leadership. You will be part of a dynamic and collaborative Product Management team responsible for driving the development and execution of product roadmaps that align with our company's vision. You will be involved in leading product discovery and execution phases, managing a portfolio of digital products, and mentoring a small team of product managers. In this role, you will have the opportunity to use your experience in creating product strategies, utilizing data-driven decision-making, and managing cross-functional collaborations. The ideal candidate will have 7+ years of experience in product management roles with management experience.
You Are: Visionary. You have a strong ability to see the big picture and create a compelling product vision that aligns with business goals. Data-Driven. You leverage data to make informed decisions and track the impact of product releases on key performance indicators. Collaborative. You work effectively across different teams, incorporating feedback from various stakeholders to improve your products. Mentor. You guide and develop product managers, helping them grow their qualitative and quantitative skills. Strategic Thinker. You can prioritize initiatives that provide the most value to a diverse user base across the organization.
You Will: Develop and communicate a product vision that outlines the future impact of your product portfolio on the company. Build and maintain a prioritized product roadmap aligned with your vision, ensuring its execution through agile methodologies. Lead an Agile development team through product discovery and execution, creating user stories and managing the product backlog. Apply data-driven strategies to inform business decisions and track the success of product releases against company KPIs. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, business partners, and stakeholders to improve products and ensure alignment with business goals. Mentor and lead a team of Product Managers and Business Analysts, guiding them through the Agile process as they develop their own visions, roadmaps, and KPIs. Act as a liaison to senior leadership, reporting on the impact and progress of your product portfolio.
Must Have’s: 7+ years of experience in a customer-facing, technology-related business role as a product manager.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
Proven success in developing business cases, roadmaps, and product execution strategies.
Demonstrated ability to work across an organization, incorporating feedback from internal stakeholders.
Prioritize capabilities that benefit the varying needs of users across a heterogeneous organization.
Strong communication skills, comfortable with varying audiences from engineers to C-level executives.
Nice to Have’s: Experience in a similar industry or with similar Digital Marketplace products.
Familiarity with advanced data analytics tools.
